1.zh: 耶和华从会幕中呼叫摩西，对他说：
1.en: The Lord called to Moses and spoketo him from the Tent of Meeting. He said,

1.zh: 你晓谕以色列人说：你们中间若有人献供物给耶和华，要从牛群羊群中献牲畜为供物。
1.en: "Speak to the Israelites and say to them: 'When any of you brings an offering to the Lord , bring as your offering an animal from either the herd or the flock.

1.zh: 他的供物若以牛为燔祭，就要在会幕门口献一只没有残疾的公牛，可以在耶和华面前蒙悦纳。
1.en: " 'If the offering is a burnt offering from the herd, he is to offer a male without defect. He must present it at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting so that it will be acceptable to the Lord .

1.zh: 他要按手在燔祭牲的头上，燔祭便蒙悦纳，为他赎罪。
1.en: He is to lay his hand on the head of the burnt offering, and it will be accepted on his behalf to make atonement for him.

1.zh: 他要在耶和华面前宰公牛；亚伦子孙作祭司的，要奉上血，把血洒在会幕门口 、 坛的周围。
1.en: He is to slaughter the young bull before the Lord , and then Aaron's sons the priests shall bring the blood and sprinkle it against the altar on all sides at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting.

1.zh: 那人要剥去燔祭牲的皮，把燔祭牲切成块子。
1.en: He is to skin the burnt offering and cut it into pieces.

1.zh: 祭司亚伦的子孙要把火放在坛上，把柴摆在火上。
1.en: The sons of Aaron the priest are to put fire on the altar and arrange wood on the fire.

1.zh: 亚伦子孙作祭司的，要把肉块和头并脂油摆在坛上火的柴上。
1.en: Then Aaron's sons the priests shall arrange the pieces, including the head and the fat, on the burning wood that is on the altar.

1.zh: 但燔祭的脏腑与腿要用水洗。祭司就要把一切全烧在坛上，当作燔祭，献与耶和华为馨香的火祭。
1.en: He is to wash the inner parts and the legs with water, and the priest is to burn all of it on the altar. It is a burnt offering, an offering made by fire, an aroma pleasing to the Lord .

1.zh: 人的供物若以绵羊或山羊为燔祭，就要献上没有残疾的公羊。
1.en: " 'If the offering is a burnt offering from the flock, from either the sheep or the goats, he is to offer a male without defect.

1.zh: 要把羊宰于坛的北边，在耶和华面前；亚伦子孙作祭司的，要把羊血洒在坛的周围。
1.en: He is to slaughter it at the north side of the altar before the Lord , and Aaron's sons the priests shall sprinkle its blood against the altar on all sides.

1.zh: 要把燔祭牲切成块子，连头和脂油，祭司就要摆在坛上火的柴上；
1.en: He is to cut it into pieces, and the priest shall arrange them, including the head and the fat, on the burning wood that is on the altar.

1.zh: 但脏腑与腿要用水洗，祭司就要全然奉献，烧在坛上。这是燔祭，是献与耶和华为馨香的火祭。
1.en: He is to wash the inner parts and the legs with water, and the priest is to bring all of it and burn it on the altar. It is a burnt offering, an offering made by fire, an aroma pleasing to the Lord .

1.zh: 人奉给耶和华的供物，若以鸟为燔祭，就要献斑鸠或是雏鸽为供物。
1.en: " 'If the offering to the Lord is a burnt offering of birds, he is to offer a dove or a young pigeon.

1.zh: 祭司要把鸟拿到坛前，揪下头来，把鸟烧在坛上；鸟的血要流在坛的旁边；
1.en: The priest shall bring it to the altar, wring off the head and burn it on the altar; its blood shall be drained out on the side of the altar.

1.zh: 又要把鸟的嗉子和脏物除掉，（脏物：或作翎毛）丢在坛的东边倒灰的地方。
1.en: He is to remove the crop with its contents and throw it to the east side of the altar, where the ashes are.

1.zh: 要拿著鸟的两个翅膀，把鸟撕开，只是不可撕断；祭司要在坛上 、 在火的柴上焚烧。这是燔祭，是献与耶和华为馨香的火祭。
1.en: He shall tear it open by the wings, not severing it completely, and then the priest shall burn it on the wood that is on the fire on the altar. It is a burnt offering, an offering made by fire, an aroma pleasing to the Lord .

2.zh: 若有人献素祭为供物给耶和华，要用细面浇上油，加上乳香，
2.en: " 'When someone brings a grain offering to the Lord , his offering is to be of fine flour. He is to pour oil on it, put incense on it

2.zh: 带到亚伦子孙作祭司的那里；祭司就要从细面中取出一把来，并取些油和所有的乳香，然后要把所取的这些作为纪念，烧在坛上，是献与耶和华为馨香的火祭。
2.en: and take it to Aaron's sons the priests. The priest shall take a handful of the fine flour and oil, together with all the incense, and burn this as a memorial portion on the altar, an offering made by fire, an aroma pleasing to the Lord .

2.zh: 素祭所剩的要归给亚伦和他的子孙；这是献与耶和华的火祭中为至圣的。
2.en: The rest of the grain offering belongs to Aaron and his sons; it is a most holy part of the offerings made to the Lord by fire.

2.zh: 若用炉中烤的物为素祭，就要用调油的无酵细面饼，或是抹油的无酵薄饼。
2.en: " 'If you bring a grain offering baked in an oven, it is to consist of fine flour: cakes made without yeast and mixed with oil, or wafers made without yeast and spread with oil.

2.zh: 若用铁鏊上做的物为素祭，就要用调油的无酵细面，
2.en: If your grain offering is prepared on a griddle, it is to be made of fine flour mixed with oil, and without yeast.

2.zh: 分成块子，浇上油；这是素祭。
2.en: Crumble it and pour oil on it; it is a grain offering.

2.zh: 若用煎盘做的物为素祭，就要用油与细面作成。
2.en: If your grain offering is cooked in a pan, it is to be made of fine flour and oil.

2.zh: 要把这些东西做的素祭带到耶和华面前，并奉给祭司，带到坛前。
2.en: Bring the grain offering made of these things to the Lord ; present it to the priest, who shall take it to the altar.

2.zh: 祭司要从素祭中取出作为纪念的，烧在坛上，是献与耶和华为馨香的火祭。
2.en: He shall take out the memorial portion from the grain offering and burn it on the altar as an offering made by fire, an aroma pleasing to the Lord .

2.zh: 素祭所剩的要归给亚伦和他的子孙。这是献与耶和华的火祭中为至圣的。
2.en: The rest of the grain offering belongs to Aaron and his sons; it is a most holy part of the offerings made to the Lord by fire.

2.zh: 凡献给耶和华的素祭都不可有酵；因为你们不可烧一点酵 、 一点蜜当作火祭献给耶和华。
2.en: " 'Every grain offering you bring to the Lord must be made without yeast, for you are not to burn any yeast or honey in an offering made to the Lord by fire.

2.zh: 这些物要献给耶和华作为初熟的供物，只是不可在坛上献为馨香的祭。
2.en: You may bring them to the Lord as an offering of the firstfruits, but they are not to be offered on the altar as a pleasing aroma.

2.zh: 凡献为素祭的供物都要用盐调和，在素祭上不可缺了你神立约的盐。一切的供物都要配盐而献。
2.en: Season all your grain offerings with salt. Do not leave the salt of the covenant of your God out of your grain offerings; add salt to all your offerings.

2.zh: 若向耶和华献初熟之物为素祭，要献上烘了的禾穗子，就是轧了的新穗子，当作初熟之物的素祭。
2.en: " 'If you bring a grain offering of firstfruits to the Lord , offer crushed heads of new grain roasted in the fire.

2.zh: 并要抹上油，加上乳香；这是素祭。
2.en: Put oil and incense on it; it is a grain offering.

2.zh: 祭司要把其中作为纪念的，就是一些轧了的禾穗子和一些油，并所有的乳香，都焚烧，是向耶和华献的火祭。
2.en: The priest shall burn the memorial portion of the crushed grain and the oil, together with all the incense, as an offering made to the Lord by fire.

3.zh: 人献供物为平安祭（平安：或作酬恩；下同），若是从牛群中献，无论是公的是母的，必用没有残疾的献在耶和华面前。
3.en: " 'If someone's offering is a fellowship offering, and he offers an animal from the herd, whether male or female, he is to present before the Lord an animal without defect.

3.zh: 他要按手在供物的头上，宰于会幕门口。亚伦子孙作祭司的，要把血洒在坛的周围。
3.en: He is to lay his hand on the head of his offering and slaughter it at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting. Then Aaron's sons the priests shall sprinkle the blood against the altar on all sides.

3.zh: 从平安祭中，将火祭献给耶和华，也要把盖脏的脂油和脏上所有的脂油，
3.en: From the fellowship offering he is to bring a sacrifice made to the Lord by fire: all the fat that covers the inner parts or is connected to them,

3.zh: 并两个腰子和腰子上的脂油，就是靠腰两旁的脂油，与肝上的网子和腰子，一概取下。
3.en: both kidneys with the fat on them near the loins, and the covering of the liver, which he will remove with the kidneys.

3.zh: 亚伦的子孙要把这些烧在坛的燔祭上，就是在火的柴上，是献与耶和华为馨香的火祭。
3.en: Then Aaron's sons are to burn it on the altar on top of the burnt offering that is on the burning wood, as an offering made by fire, an aroma pleasing to the Lord .

3.zh: 人向耶和华献供物为平安祭，若是从羊群中献，无论是公的是母的，必用没有残疾的。
3.en: " 'If he offers an animal from the flock as a fellowship offering to the Lord , he is to offer a male or female without defect.

3.zh: 若献一只羊羔为供物，必在耶和华面前献上，
3.en: If he offers a lamb, he is to present it before the Lord .

3.zh: 并要按手在供物的头上，宰于会幕前。亚伦的子孙要把血洒在坛的周围。
3.en: He is to lay his hand on the head of his offering and slaughter it in front of the Tent of Meeting. Then Aaron's sons shall sprinkle its blood against the altar on all sides.

3.zh: 从平安祭中，将火祭献给耶和华，其中的脂油和整肥尾巴都要在靠近脊骨处取下，并要把盖脏的脂油和脏上所有的脂油，
3.en: From the fellowship offering he is to bring a sacrifice made to the Lord by fire: its fat, the entire fat tail cut off close to the backbone, all the fat that covers the inner parts or is connected to them,

3.zh: 两个腰子和腰子上的脂油，就是靠腰两旁的脂油，并肝上的网子和腰子，一概取下。
3.en: both kidneys with the fat on them near the loins, and the covering of the liver, which he will remove with the kidneys.

3.zh: 祭司要在坛上焚烧，是献给耶和华为食物的火祭。
3.en: The priest shall burn them on the altar as food, an offering made to the Lord by fire.

3.zh: 人的供物若是山羊，必在耶和华面前献上。
3.en: " 'If his offering is a goat, he is to present it before the Lord .

3.zh: 要按手在山羊头上，宰于会幕前。亚伦的子孙要把血洒在坛的周围，
3.en: He is to lay his hand on its head and slaughter it in front of the Tent of Meeting. Then Aaron's sons shall sprinkle its blood against the altar on all sides.

3.zh: 又把盖脏的脂油和脏上所有的脂油，两个腰子和腰子上的脂油，就是靠腰两旁的脂油，并肝上的网子和腰子，一概取下，献给耶和华为火祭。
3.en: From what he offers he is to make this offering to the Lord by fire: all the fat that covers the inner parts or is connected to them,
both kidneys with the fat on them near the loins, and the covering of the liver, which he will remove with the kidneys.

3.zh: 祭司要在坛上焚烧，作为馨香火祭的食物。脂油都是耶和华的。
3.en: The priest shall burn them on the altar as food, an offering made by fire, a pleasing aroma. All the fat is the Lord 's.

3.zh: 在你们一切的住处，脂油和血都不可吃；这要成为你们世世代代永远的定例。
3.en: " 'This is a lasting ordinance for the generations to come, wherever you live: You must not eat any fat or any blood.' "

4.zh: 耶和华对摩西说：
4.en: The Lord said to Moses,

4.zh: 你晓谕以色列人说：若有人在耶和华所吩咐不可行的甚么事上误犯了一件，
4.en: "Say to the Israelites: 'When anyone sins unintentionally and does what is forbidden in any of the Lord 's commands-

4.zh: 或是受膏的祭司犯罪，使百姓陷在罪里，就当为他所犯的罪把没有残疾的公牛犊献给耶和华为赎罪祭。
4.en: " 'If the anointed priest sins, bringing guilt on the people, he must bring to the Lord a young bull without defect as a sin offering for the sin he has committed.

4.zh: 他要牵公牛到会幕门口，在耶和华面前按手在牛的头上，把牛宰于耶和华面前。
4.en: He is to present the bull at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting before the Lord . He is to lay his hand on its head and slaughter it before the Lord .

4.zh: 受膏的祭司要取些公牛的血带到会幕，
4.en: Then the anointed priest shall take some of the bull's blood and carry it into the Tent of Meeting.

4.zh: 把指头蘸于血中，在耶和华面前对著圣所的幔子弹血七次，
4.en: He is to dip his finger into the blood and sprinkle some of it seven times before the Lord , in front of the curtain of the sanctuary.

4.zh: 又要把些血抹在会幕内 、 耶和华面前香坛的四角上，再把公牛所有的血倒在会幕门口 、 燔祭坛的脚那里。
4.en: The priest shall then put some of the blood on the horns of the altar of fragrant incense that is before the Lord in the Tent of Meeting. The rest of the bull's blood he shall pour out at the base of the altar of burnt offering at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting.

4.zh: 要把赎罪祭公牛所有的脂油，乃是盖脏的脂油和脏上所有的脂油，
4.en: He shall remove all the fat from the bull of the sin offering-the fat that covers the inner parts or is connected to them,

4.zh: 并两个腰子和腰子上的脂油，就是靠腰两旁的脂油，与肝上的网子和腰子，一概取下，
4.en: both kidneys with the fat on them near the loins, and the covering of the liver, which he will remove with the kidneys-

4.zh: 与平安祭公牛上所取的一样；祭司要把这些烧在燔祭的坛上。
4.en: just as the fat is removed from the ox sacrificed as a fellowship offering. Then the priest shall burn them on the altar of burnt offering.

4.zh: 公牛的皮和所有的肉，并头 、 腿 、 脏 、 腑 、 粪，
4.en: But the hide of the bull and all its flesh, as well as the head and legs, the inner parts and offal-

4.zh: 就是全公牛，要搬到营外洁净之地 、 倒灰之所，用火烧在柴上。
4.en: that is, all the rest of the bull-he must take outside the camp to a place ceremonially clean, where the ashes are thrown, and burn it in a wood fire on the ash heap.

4.zh: 以色列全会众若行了耶和华所吩咐不可行的甚么事，误犯了罪，是隐而未现，会众看不出来的，
4.en: " 'If the whole Israelite community sins unintentionally and does what is forbidden in any of the Lord 's commands, even though the community is unaware of the matter, they are guilty.

4.zh: 会众一知道所犯的罪就要献一只公牛犊为赎罪祭，牵到会幕前。
4.en: When they become aware of the sin they committed, the assembly must bring a young bull as a sin offering and present it before the Tent of Meeting.

4.zh: 会中的长老就要在耶和华面前按手在牛的头上，将牛在耶和华面前宰了。
4.en: The elders of the community are to lay their hands on the bull's head before the Lord , and the bull shall be slaughtered before the Lord .

4.zh: 受膏的祭司要取些公牛的血带到会幕，
4.en: Then the anointed priest is to take some of the bull's blood into the Tent of Meeting.

4.zh: 把指头蘸于血中，在耶和华面前对著幔子弹血七次，
4.en: He shall dip his finger into the blood and sprinkle it before the Lord seven times in front of the curtain.

4.zh: 又要把些血抹在会幕内 、 耶和华面前坛的四角上，再把所有的血倒在会幕门口 、 燔祭坛的脚那里。
4.en: He is to put some of the blood on the horns of the altar that is before the Lord in the Tent of Meeting. The rest of the blood he shall pour out at the base of the altar of burnt offering at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting.

4.zh: 把牛所有的脂油都取下，烧在坛上；
4.en: He shall remove all the fat from it and burn it on the altar,

4.zh: 收拾这牛，与那赎罪祭的牛一样。祭司要为他们赎罪，他们必蒙赦免。
4.en: and do with this bull just as he did with the bull for the sin offering. In this way the priest will make atonement for them, and they will be forgiven.

4.zh: 他要把牛搬到营外烧了，像烧头一个牛一样；这是会众的赎罪祭。
4.en: Then he shall take the bull outside the camp and burn it as he burned the first bull. This is the sin offering for the community.

4.zh: 官长若行了耶和华 ─ 他神所吩咐不可行的甚么事，误犯了罪，
4.en: " 'When a leader sins unintentionally and does what is forbidden in any of the commands of the Lord his God, he is guilty.

4.zh: 所犯的罪自己知道了，就要牵一只没有残疾的公山羊为供物，
4.en: When he is made aware of the sin he committed, he must bring as his offering a male goat without defect.

4.zh: 按手在羊的头上，宰于耶和华面前 、 宰燔祭牲的地方；这是赎罪祭。
4.en: He is to lay his hand on the goat's head and slaughter it at the place where the burnt offering is slaughtered before the Lord . It is a sin offering.

4.zh: 祭司要用指头蘸些赎罪祭牲的血，抹在燔祭坛的四角上，把血倒在燔祭坛的脚那里。
4.en: Then the priest shall take some of the blood of the sin offering with his finger and put it on the horns of the altar of burnt offering and pour out the rest of the blood at the base of the altar.

4.zh: 所有的脂油，祭司都要烧在坛上，正如平安祭的脂油一样。至于他的罪，祭司要为他赎了，他必蒙赦免。
4.en: He shall burn all the fat on the altar as he burned the fat of the fellowship offering. In this way the priest will make atonement for the man's sin, and he will be forgiven.

4.zh: 民中若有人行了耶和华所吩咐不可行的甚么事，误犯了罪，
4.en: " 'If a member of the community sins unintentionally and does what is forbidden in any of the Lord 's commands, he is guilty.

4.zh: 所犯的罪自己知道了，就要为所犯的罪牵一只没有残疾的母山羊为供物，
4.en: When he is made aware of the sin he committed, he must bring as his offering for the sin he committed a female goat without defect.

4.zh: 按手在赎罪祭牲的头上，在那宰燔祭牲的地方宰了。
4.en: He is to lay his hand on the head of the sin offering and slaughter it at the place of the burnt offering.

4.zh: 祭司要用指头蘸些羊的血，抹在燔祭坛的四角上，所有的血都要倒在坛的脚那里，
4.en: Then the priest is to take some of the blood with his finger and put it on the horns of the altar of burnt offering and pour out the rest of the blood at the base of the altar.

4.zh: 又要把羊所有的脂油都取下，正如取平安祭牲的脂油一样。祭司要在坛上焚烧，在耶和华面前作为馨香的祭，为他赎罪，他必蒙赦免。
4.en: He shall remove all the fat, just as the fat is removed from the fellowship offering, and the priest shall burn it on the altar as an aroma pleasing to the Lord . In this way the priest will make atonement for him, and he will be forgiven.

4.zh: 人若牵一只绵羊羔为赎罪祭的供物，必要牵一只没有残疾的母羊，
4.en: " 'If he brings a lamb as his sin offering, he is to bring a female without defect.

4.zh: 按手在赎罪祭牲的头上，在那宰燔祭牲的地方宰了作赎罪祭。
4.en: He is to lay his hand on its head and slaughter it for a sin offering at the place where the burnt offering is slaughtered.

4.zh: 祭司要用指头蘸些赎罪祭牲的血，抹在燔祭坛的四角上，所有的血都要倒在坛的脚那里，
4.en: Then the priest shall take some of the blood of the sin offering with his finger and put it on the horns of the altar of burnt offering and pour out the rest of the blood at the base of the altar.

4.zh: 又要把所有的脂油都取下，正如取平安祭羊羔的脂油一样。祭司要按献给耶和华火祭的条例，烧在坛上。至于所犯的罪，祭司要为他赎了，他必蒙赦免。
4.en: He shall remove all the fat, just as the fat is removed from the lamb of the fellowship offering, and the priest shall burn it on the altar on top of the offerings made to the Lord by fire. In this way the priest will make atonement for him for the sin he has committed, and he will be forgiven.

5.zh: 若有人听见发誓的声音（或作：若有人听见叫人发誓的声音），他本是见证，却不把所看见的 、 所知道的说出来，这就是罪；他要担当他的罪孽。
5.en: " 'If a person sins because he does not speak up when he hears a public charge to testify regarding something he has seen or learned about, he will be held responsible.

5.zh: 或是有人摸了不洁的物，无论是不洁的死兽，是不洁的死畜，是不洁的死虫，他却不知道，因此成了不洁，就有了罪。
5.en: " 'Or if a person touches anything ceremonially unclean-whether the carcasses of unclean wild animals or of unclean livestock or of unclean creatures that move along the ground-even though he is unaware of it, he has become unclean and is guilty.

5.zh: 或是他摸了别人的污秽，无论是染了甚么污秽，他却不知道，一知道了就有了罪。
5.en: " 'Or if he touches human uncleanness-anything that would make him unclean-even though he is unaware of it, when he learns of it he will be guilty.

5.zh: 或是有人嘴里冒失发誓，要行恶，要行善，无论人在甚么事上冒失发誓，他却不知道，一知道了就要在这其中的一件上有了罪。
5.en: " 'Or if a person thoughtlessly takes an oath to do anything, whether good or evil-in any matter one might carelessly swear about-even though he is unaware of it, in any case when he learns of it he will be guilty.

5.zh: 他有了罪的时候，就要承认所犯的罪，
5.en: " 'When anyone is guilty in any of these ways, he must confess in what way he has sinned

5.zh: 并要因所犯的罪，把他的赎愆祭牲 ─ 就是羊群中的母羊，或是一只羊羔，或是一只山羊 ─ 牵到耶和华面前为赎罪祭。至于他的罪，祭司要为他赎了。
5.en: and, as a penalty for the sin he has committed, he must bring to the Lord a female lamb or goat from the flock as a sin offering; and the priest shall make atonement for him for his sin.

5.zh: 他的力量若不够献一只羊羔，就要因所犯的罪，把两只斑鸠或是两只雏鸽带到耶和华面前为赎愆祭：一只作赎罪祭，一只作燔祭。
5.en: " 'If he cannot afford a lamb, he is to bring two doves or two young pigeons to the Lord as a penalty for his sin-one for a sin offering and the other for a burnt offering.

5.zh: 把这些带到祭司那里，祭司就要先把那赎罪祭献上，从鸟的颈项上揪下头来，只是不可把鸟撕断，
5.en: He is to bring them to the priest, who shall first offer the one for the sin offering. He is to wring its head from its neck, not severing it completely,

5.zh: 也把些赎罪祭牲的血弹在坛的旁边，剩下的血要流在坛的脚那里；这是赎罪祭。
5.en: and is to sprinkle some of the blood of the sin offering against the side of the altar; the rest of the blood must be drained out at the base of the altar. It is a sin offering.

5.zh: 他要照例献第二只为燔祭。至于他所犯的罪，祭司要为他赎了，他必蒙赦免。
5.en: The priest shall then offer the other as a burnt offering in the prescribed way and make atonement for him for the sin he has committed, and he will be forgiven.

5.zh: 他的力量若不够献两只斑鸠或是两只雏鸽，就要因所犯的罪带供物来，就是细面伊法十分之一为赎罪祭；不可加上油，也不可加上乳香，因为是赎罪祭。
5.en: " 'If, however, he cannot afford two doves or two young pigeons, he is to bring as an offering for his sin a tenth of an ephah of fine flour for a sin offering. He must not put oil or incense on it, because it is a sin offering.

5.zh: 他要把供物带到祭司那里，祭司要取出自己的一把来作为纪念，按献给耶和华火祭的条例烧在坛上；这是赎罪祭。
5.en: He is to bring it to the priest, who shall take a handful of it as a memorial portion and burn it on the altar on top of the offerings made to the Lord by fire. It is a sin offering.

5.zh: 至于他在这几件事中所犯的罪，祭司要为他赎了，他必蒙赦免。剩下的面都归与祭司，和素祭一样。
5.en: In this way the priest will make atonement for him for any of these sins he has committed, and he will be forgiven. The rest of the offering will belong to the priest, as in the case of the grain offering.' "

5.zh: 人若在耶和华的圣物上误犯了罪，有了过犯，就要照你所估的，按圣所的舍客勒拿银子，将赎愆祭牲 ─ 就是羊群中一只没有残疾的公绵羊 ─ 牵到耶和华面前为赎愆祭；
5.en: "When a person commits a violation and sins unintentionally in regard to any of the Lord 's holy things, he is to bring to the Lord as a penalty a ram from the flock, one without defect and of the proper value in silver, according to the sanctuary shekel. It is a guilt offering.

5.zh: 并且他因在圣物上的差错要偿还，另外加五分之一，都给祭司。祭司要用赎愆祭的公绵羊为他赎罪，他必蒙赦免。
5.en: He must make restitution for what he has failed to do in regard to the holy things, add a fifth of the value to that and give it all to the priest, who will make atonement for him with the ram as a guilt offering, and he will be forgiven.

5.zh: 若有人犯罪，行了耶和华所吩咐不可行的甚么事，他虽然不知道，还是有了罪，就要担当他的罪孽；
5.en: "If a person sins and does what is forbidden in any of the Lord 's commands, even though he does not know it, he is guilty and will be held responsible.

5.zh: 也要照你所估定的价，从羊群中牵一只没有残疾的公绵羊来，给祭司作赎愆祭。至于他误行的那错事，祭司要为他赎罪，他必蒙赦免。
5.en: He is to bring to the priest as a guilt offering a ram from the flock, one without defect and of the proper value. In this way the priest will make atonement for him for the wrong he has committed unintentionally, and he will be forgiven.

5.zh: 这是赎愆祭，因他在耶和华面前实在有了罪。
5.en: It is a guilt offering; he has been guilty of wrongdoing against the Lord ."

6.zh: 耶和华晓谕摩西说：
6.en: The Lord said to Moses:

6.zh: 若有人犯罪，干犯耶和华，在邻舍交付他的物上，或是在交易上行了诡诈，或是抢夺人的财物，或是欺压邻舍，
6.en: "If anyone sins and is unfaithful to the Lord by deceiving his neighbor about something entrusted to him or left in his care or stolen, or if he cheats him,

6.zh: 或是在捡了遗失的物上行了诡诈，说谎起誓，在这一切的事上犯了甚么罪；
6.en: or if he finds lost property and lies about it, or if he swears falsely, or if he commits any such sin that people may do-

6.zh: 他既犯了罪，有了过犯，就要归还他所抢夺的，或是因欺压所得的，或是人交付他的，或是人遗失他所捡的物，
6.en: when he thus sins and becomes guilty, he must return what he has stolen or taken by extortion, or what was entrusted to him, or the lost property he found,

6.zh: 或是他因甚么物起了假誓，就要如数归还，另外加上五分之一，在查出他有罪的日子要交还本主。
6.en: or whatever it was he swore falsely about. He must make restitution in full, add a fifth of the value to it and give it all to the owner on the day he presents his guilt offering.

6.zh: 也要照你所估定的价，把赎愆祭牲 ─ 就是羊群中一只没有残疾的公绵羊 ─ 牵到耶和华面前，给祭司为赎愆祭。
6.en: And as a penalty he must bring to the priest, that is, to the Lord , his guilt offering, a ram from the flock, one without defect and of the proper value.

6.zh: 祭司要在耶和华面前为他赎罪；他无论行了甚么事，使他有了罪，都必蒙赦免。
6.en: In this way the priest will make atonement for him before the Lord , and he will be forgiven for any of these things he did that made him guilty."

6.zh: 耶和华晓谕摩西说：
6.en: The Lord said to Moses:

6.zh: 你要吩咐亚伦和他的子孙说，燔祭的条例乃是这样：燔祭要放在坛的柴上，从晚上到天亮，坛上的火要常常烧著。
6.en: "Give Aaron and his sons this command: 'These are the regulations for the burnt offering: The burnt offering is to remain on the altar hearth throughout the night, till morning, and the fire must be kept burning on the altar.

6.zh: 祭司要穿上细麻布衣服，又要把细麻布裤子穿在身上，把坛上所烧的燔祭灰收起来，倒在坛的旁边；
6.en: The priest shall then put on his linen clothes, with linen undergarments next to his body, and shall remove the ashes of the burnt offering that the fire has consumed on the altar and place them beside the altar.

6.zh: 随后要脱去这衣服，穿上别的衣服，把灰拿到营外洁净之处。
6.en: Then he is to take off these clothes and put on others, and carry the ashes outside the camp to a place that is ceremonially clean.

6.zh: 坛上的火要在其上常常烧著，不可熄灭。祭司要每日早晨在上面烧柴，并要把燔祭摆在坛上，在其上烧平安祭牲的脂油。
6.en: The fire on the altar must be kept burning; it must not go out. Every morning the priest is to add firewood and arrange the burnt offering on the fire and burn the fat of the fellowship offerings on it.

6.zh: 在坛上必有常常烧著的火，不可熄灭。
6.en: The fire must be kept burning on the altar continuously; it must not go out.

6.zh: 素祭的条例乃是这样：亚伦的子孙要在坛前把这祭献在耶和华面前。
6.en: " 'These are the regulations for the grain offering: Aaron's sons are to bring it before the Lord , in front of the altar.

6.zh: 祭司要从其中 ─ 就是从素祭的细面中 ─ 取出自己的一把，又要取些油和素祭上所有的乳香，烧在坛上，奉给耶和华为馨香素祭的纪念。
6.en: The priest is to take a handful of fine flour and oil, together with all the incense on the grain offering, and burn the memorial portion on the altar as an aroma pleasing to the Lord .

6.zh: 所剩下的，亚伦和他子孙要吃，必在圣处不带酵而吃，要在会幕的院子里吃。
6.en: Aaron and his sons shall eat the rest of it, but it is to be eaten without yeast in a holy place; they are to eat it in the courtyard of the Tent of Meeting.

6.zh: 烤的时候不可搀酵。这是从所献给我的火祭中赐给他们的分，是至圣的，和赎罪祭并赎愆祭一样。
6.en: It must not be baked with yeast; I have given it as their share of the offerings made to me by fire. Like the sin offering and the guilt offering, it is most holy.

6.zh: 凡献给耶和华的火祭，亚伦子孙中的男丁都要吃这一分，直到万代，作他们永得的分。摸这些祭物的，都要成为圣。
6.en: Any male descendant of Aaron may eat it. It is his regular share of the offerings made to the Lord by fire for the generations to come. Whatever touches them will become holy. ' "

6.zh: 耶和华晓谕摩西说：
6.en: The Lord also said to Moses,

6.zh: 当亚伦受膏的日子，他和他子孙所要献给耶和华的供物，就是细面伊法十分之一，为常献的素祭：早晨一半，晚上一半。
6.en: "This is the offering Aaron and his sons are to bring to the Lord on the day he is anointed: a tenth of an ephah of fine flour as a regular grain offering, half of it in the morning and half in the evening.

6.zh: 要在铁鏊上用油调和做成，调匀了，你就拿进来；烤好了分成块子，献给耶和华为馨香的素祭。
6.en: Prepare it with oil on a griddle; bring it well-mixed and present the grain offering broken in pieces as an aroma pleasing to the Lord .

6.zh: 亚伦的子孙中，接续他为受膏的祭司，要把这素祭献上，要全烧给耶和华。这是永远的定例。
6.en: The son who is to succeed him as anointed priest shall prepare it. It is the Lord 's regular share and is to be burned completely.

6.zh: 祭司的素祭都要烧了，却不可吃。
6.en: Every grain offering of a priest shall be burned completely; it must not be eaten."

6.zh: 耶和华晓谕摩西说：
6.en: The Lord said to Moses,

6.zh: 你对亚伦和他的子孙说，赎罪祭的条例乃是这样：要在耶和华面前 、 宰燔祭牲的地方宰赎罪祭牲；这是至圣的。
6.en: "Say to Aaron and his sons: 'These are the regulations for the sin offering: The sin offering is to be slaughtered before the Lord in the place the burnt offering is slaughtered; it is most holy.

6.zh: 为赎罪献这祭的祭司要吃，要在圣处，就是在会幕的院子里吃。
6.en: The priest who offers it shall eat it; it is to be eaten in a holy place, in the courtyard of the Tent of Meeting.

6.zh: 凡摸这祭肉的要成为圣；这祭牲的血若弹在甚么衣服上，所弹的那一件要在圣处洗净。
6.en: Whatever touches any of the flesh will become holy, and if any of the blood is spattered on a garment, you must wash it in a holy place.

6.zh: 惟有煮祭物的瓦器要打碎；若是煮在铜器里，这铜器要擦磨，在水中涮净。
6.en: The clay pot the meat is cooked in must be broken; but if it is cooked in a bronze pot, the pot is to be scoured and rinsed with water.

6.zh: 凡祭司中的男丁都可以吃；这是至圣的。
6.en: Any male in a priest's family may eat it; it is most holy.

6.zh: 凡赎罪祭，若将血带进会幕在圣所赎罪，那肉都不可吃，必用火焚烧。
6.en: But any sin offering whose blood is brought into the Tent of Meeting to make atonement in the Holy Place must not be eaten; it must be burned.

7.zh: 赎愆祭的条例乃是如此：这祭是至圣的。
7.en: " 'These are the regulations for theguilt offering, which is most holy:

7.zh: 人在那里宰燔祭牲，也要在那里宰赎愆祭牲；其血，祭司要洒在坛的周围。
7.en: The guilt offering is to be slaughtered in the place where the burnt offering is slaughtered, and its blood is to be sprinkled against the altar on all sides.

7.zh: 又要将肥尾巴和盖脏的脂油，
7.en: All its fat shall be offered: the fat tail and the fat that covers the inner parts,

7.zh: 两个腰子和腰子上的脂油，就是靠腰两旁的脂油，并肝上的网子和腰子，一概取下。
7.en: both kidneys with the fat on them near the loins, and the covering of the liver, which is to be removed with the kidneys.

7.zh: 祭司要在坛上焚烧，为献给耶和华的火祭，是赎愆祭。
7.en: The priest shall burn them on the altar as an offering made to the Lord by fire. It is a guilt offering.

7.zh: 祭司中的男丁都可以吃这祭物；要在圣处吃，是至圣的。
7.en: Any male in a priest's family may eat it, but it must be eaten in a holy place; it is most holy.

7.zh: 赎罪祭怎样，赎愆祭也是怎样，两个祭是一个条例。献赎愆祭赎罪的祭司要得这祭物。
7.en: " 'The same law applies to both the sin offering and the guilt offering: They belong to the priest who makes atonement with them.

7.zh: 献燔祭的祭司，无论为谁奉献，要亲自得他所献那燔祭牲的皮。
7.en: The priest who offers a burnt offering for anyone may keep its hide for himself.

7.zh: 凡在炉中烤的素祭和煎盘中做的，并铁鏊上做的，都要归那献祭的祭司。
7.en: Every grain offering baked in an oven or cooked in a pan or on a griddle belongs to the priest who offers it,

7.zh: 凡素祭，无论是油调和的是干的，都要归亚伦的子孙，大家均分。
7.en: and every grain offering, whether mixed with oil or dry, belongs equally to all the sons of Aaron.

7.zh: 人献与耶和华平安祭的条例乃是这样：
7.en: " 'These are the regulations for the fellowship offering a person may present to the Lord :

7.zh: 他若为感谢献上，就要用调油的无酵饼和抹油的无酵薄饼，并用油调匀细面做的饼，与感谢祭一同献上。
7.en: " 'If he offers it as an expression of thankfulness, then along with this thank offering he is to offer cakes of bread made without yeast and mixed with oil, wafers made without yeast and spread with oil, and cakes of fine flour well-kneaded and mixed with oil.

7.zh: 要用有酵的饼和为感谢献的平安祭，与供物一同献上。
7.en: Along with his fellowship offering of thanksgiving he is to present an offering with cakes of bread made with yeast.

7.zh: 从各样的供物中，他要把一个饼献给耶和华为举祭，是要归给洒平安祭牲血的祭司。
7.en: He is to bring one of each kind as an offering, a contribution to the Lord ; it belongs to the priest who sprinkles the blood of the fellowship offerings.

7.zh: 为感谢献平安祭牲的肉，要在献的日子吃，一点不可留到早晨。
7.en: The meat of his fellowship offering of thanksgiving must be eaten on the day it is offered; he must leave none of it till morning.

7.zh: 若所献的是为还愿，或是甘心献的，必在献祭的日子吃，所剩下的第二天也可以吃。
7.en: " 'If, however, his offering is the result of a vow or is a freewill offering, the sacrifice shall be eaten on the day he offers it, but anything left over may be eaten on the next day.

7.zh: 但所剩下的祭肉，到第三天要用火焚烧；
7.en: Any meat of the sacrifice left over till the third day must be burned up.

7.zh: 第三天若吃了平安祭的肉，这祭必不蒙悦纳，人所献的也不算为祭，反为可憎嫌的，吃这祭肉的，就必担当他的罪孽。
7.en: If any meat of the fellowship offering is eaten on the third day, it will not be accepted. It will not be credited to the one who offered it, for it is impure; the person who eats any of it will be held responsible.

7.zh: 挨了污秽物的肉就不可吃，要用火焚烧。至于平安祭的肉，凡洁净的人都要吃；
7.en: " 'Meat that touches anything ceremonially unclean must not be eaten; it must be burned up. As for other meat, anyone ceremonially clean may eat it.

7.zh: 只是献与耶和华平安祭的肉，人若不洁净而吃了，这人必从民中剪除。
7.en: But if anyone who is unclean eats any meat of the fellowship offering belonging to the Lord , that person must be cut off from his people.

7.zh: 有人摸了甚么不洁净的物，或是人的不洁净，或是不洁净的牲畜，或是不洁可憎之物，吃了献与耶和华平安祭的肉，这人必从民中剪除。
7.en: If anyone touches something unclean-whether human uncleanness or an unclean animal or any unclean, detestable thing-and then eats any of the meat of the fellowship offering belonging to the Lord , that person must be cut off from his people.' "

7.zh: 耶和华对摩西说：
7.en: The Lord said to Moses,

7.zh: 你晓谕以色列人说：牛的脂油 、 绵羊的脂油 、 山羊的脂油，你们都不可吃。
7.en: "Say to the Israelites: 'Do not eat any of the fat of cattle, sheep or goats.

7.zh: 自死的和被野兽撕裂的，那脂油可以做别的使用，只是你们万不可吃。
7.en: The fat of an animal found dead or torn by wild animals may be used for any other purpose, but you must not eat it.

7.zh: 无论何人吃了献给耶和华当火祭牲畜的脂油，那人必从民中剪除。
7.en: Anyone who eats the fat of an animal from which an offering by fire may be made to the Lord must be cut off from his people.

7.zh: 在你们一切的住处，无论是雀鸟的血是野兽的血，你们都不可吃。
7.en: And wherever you live, you must not eat the blood of any bird or animal.

7.zh: 无论是谁吃血，那人必从民中剪除。
7.en: If anyone eats blood, that person must be cut off from his people.' "

7.zh: 耶和华对摩西说：
7.en: The Lord said to Moses,

7.zh: 你晓谕以色列人说：献平安祭给耶和华的，要从平安祭中取些来奉给耶和华。
7.en: "Say to the Israelites: 'Anyone who brings a fellowship offering to the Lord is to bring part of it as his sacrifice to the Lord .

7.zh: 他亲手献给耶和华的火祭，就是脂油和胸，要带来，好把胸在耶和华面前作摇祭，摇一摇。
7.en: With his own hands he is to bring the offering made to the Lord by fire; he is to bring the fat, together with the breast, and wave the breast before the Lord as a wave offering.

7.zh: 祭司要把脂油在坛上焚烧，但胸要归亚伦和他的子孙。
7.en: The priest shall burn the fat on the altar, but the breast belongs to Aaron and his sons.

7.zh: 你们要从平安祭中把右腿作举祭，奉给祭司。
7.en: You are to give the right thigh of your fellowship offerings to the priest as a contribution.

7.zh: 亚伦子孙中，献平安祭牲血和脂油的，要得这右腿为分；
7.en: The son of Aaron who offers the blood and the fat of the fellowship offering shall have the right thigh as his share.

7.zh: 因为我从以色列人的平安祭中，取了这摇的胸和举的腿给祭司亚伦和他子孙，作他们从以色列人中所永得的分。
7.en: From the fellowship offerings of the Israelites, I have taken the breast that is waved and the thigh that is presented and have given them to Aaron the priest and his sons as their regular share from the Israelites.' "

7.zh: 这是从耶和华火祭中，作亚伦受膏的分和他子孙受膏的分，正在摩西（原文是他）叫他们前来给耶和华供祭司职分的日子，
7.en: This is the portion of the offerings made to the Lord by fire that were allotted to Aaron and his sons on the day they were presented to serve the Lord as priests.

7.zh: 就是在摩西（原文是他）膏他们的日子，耶和华吩咐以色列人给他们的。这是他们世世代代永得的分。
7.en: On the day they were anointed, the Lord commanded that the Israelites give this to them as their regular share for the generations to come.

7.zh: 这就是燔祭 、 素祭 、 赎罪祭 、 赎愆祭，和平安祭的条例，并承接圣职的礼，
7.en: These, then, are the regulations for the burnt offering, the grain offering, the sin offering, the guilt offering, the ordination offering and the fellowship offering,

7.zh: 都是耶和华在西乃山所吩咐摩西的，就是他在西乃旷野吩咐以色列人献供物给耶和华之日所说的。
7.en: which the Lord gave Moses on Mount Sinai on the day he commanded the Israelites to bring their offerings to the Lord , in the Desert of Sinai.

8.zh: 耶和华晓谕摩西说：
8.en: The Lord said to Moses,

8.zh: 你将亚伦和他儿子一同带来，并将圣衣 、 膏油，与赎罪祭的一只公牛 、 两只公绵羊 、 一筐无酵饼都带来，
8.en: "Bring Aaron and his sons, their garments, the anointing oil, the bull for the sin offering, the two rams and the basket containing bread made without yeast,

8.zh: 又招聚会众到会幕门口。
8.en: and gather the entire assembly at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting."

8.zh: 摩西就照耶和华所吩咐的行了；于是会众聚集在会幕门口。
8.en: Moses did as the Lord commanded him, and the assembly gathered at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting.

8.zh: 摩西告诉会众说：这就是耶和华所吩咐当行的事。
8.en: Moses said to the assembly, "This is what the Lord has commanded to be done."

8.zh: 摩西带了亚伦和他儿子来，用水洗了他们。
8.en: Then Moses brought Aaron and his sons forward and washed them with water.

8.zh: 给亚伦穿上内袍，束上腰带，穿上外袍，又加上以弗得，用其上巧工织的带子把以弗得系在他身上，
8.en: He put the tunic on Aaron, tied the sash around him, clothed him with the robe and put the ephod on him. He also tied the ephod to him by its skillfully woven waistband; so it was fastened on him.

8.zh: 又给他戴上胸牌，把乌陵和土明放在胸牌内，
8.en: He placed the breastpiece on him and put the Urim and Thummim in the breastpiece.

8.zh: 把冠冕戴在他头上，在冠冕的前面钉上金牌，就是圣冠，都是照耶和华所吩咐摩西的。
8.en: Then he placed the turban on Aaron's head and set the gold plate, the sacred diadem, on the front of it, as the Lord commanded Moses.

8.zh: 摩西用膏油抹帐幕和其中所有的，使他成圣；
8.en: Then Moses took the anointing oil and anointed the tabernacle and everything in it, and so consecrated them.

8.zh: 又用膏油在坛上弹了七次，又抹了坛和坛的一切器皿，并洗濯盆和盆座，使他成圣；
8.en: He sprinkled some of the oil on the altar seven times, anointing the altar and all its utensils and the basin with its stand, to consecrate them.

8.zh: 又把膏油倒在亚伦的头上膏他，使他成圣。
8.en: He poured some of the anointing oil on Aaron's head and anointed him to consecrate him.

8.zh: 摩西带了亚伦的儿子来，给他们穿上内袍，束上腰带，包上裹头巾，都是照耶和华所吩咐摩西的。
8.en: Then he brought Aaron's sons forward, put tunics on them, tied sashes around them and put headbands on them, as the Lord commanded Moses.

8.zh: 他牵了赎罪祭的公牛来，亚伦和他儿子按手在赎罪祭公牛的头上，
8.en: He then presented the bull for the sin offering, and Aaron and his sons laid their hands on its head.

8.zh: 就宰了公牛。摩西用指头蘸血，抹在坛上四角的周围，使坛洁净，把血倒在坛的脚那里，使坛成圣，坛就洁净了；
8.en: Moses slaughtered the bull and took some of the blood, and with his finger he put it on all the horns of the altar to purify the altar. He poured out the rest of the blood at the base of the altar. So he consecrated it to make atonement for it.

8.zh: 又取脏上所有的脂油和肝上的网子，并两个腰子与腰子上的脂油，都烧在坛上；
8.en: Moses also took all the fat around the inner parts, the covering of the liver, and both kidneys and their fat, and burned it on the altar.

8.zh: 惟有公牛，连皮带肉并粪，用火烧在营外，都是照耶和华所吩咐摩西的。
8.en: But the bull with its hide and its flesh and its offal he burned up outside the camp, as the Lord commanded Moses.

8.zh: 他奉上燔祭的公绵羊；亚伦和他儿子按手在羊的头上，
8.en: He then presented the ram for the burnt offering, and Aaron and his sons laid their hands on its head.

8.zh: 就宰了公羊。摩西把血洒在坛的周围，
8.en: Then Moses slaughtered the ram and sprinkled the blood against the altar on all sides.

8.zh: 把羊切成块子，把头和肉块并脂油都烧了。
8.en: He cut the ram into pieces and burned the head, the pieces and the fat.

8.zh: 用水洗了脏腑和腿，就把全羊烧在坛上为馨香的燔祭，是献给耶和华的火祭，都是照耶和华所吩咐摩西的。
8.en: He washed the inner parts and the legs with water and burned the whole ram on the altar as a burnt offering, a pleasing aroma, an offering made to the Lord by fire, as the Lord commanded Moses.

8.zh: 他又奉上第二只公绵羊，就是承接圣职之礼的羊；亚伦和他儿子按手在羊的头上，
8.en: He then presented the other ram, the ram for the ordination, and Aaron and his sons laid their hands on its head.

8.zh: 就宰了羊。摩西把些血抹在亚伦的右耳垂上和右手的大拇指上，并右脚的大拇指上，
8.en: Moses slaughtered the ram and took some of its blood and put it on the lobe of Aaron's right ear, on the thumb of his right hand and on the big toe of his right foot.

8.zh: 又带了亚伦的儿子来，把些血抹在他们的右耳垂上和右手的大拇指上，并右脚的大拇指上，又把血洒在坛的周围。
8.en: Moses also brought Aaron's sons forward and put some of the blood on the lobes of their right ears, on the thumbs of their right hands and on the big toes of their right feet. Then he sprinkled blood against the altar on all sides.

8.zh: 取脂油和肥尾巴，并脏上一切的脂油与肝上的网子，两个腰子和腰子上的脂油，并右腿，
8.en: He took the fat, the fat tail, all the fat around the inner parts, the covering of the liver, both kidneys and their fat and the right thigh.

8.zh: 再从耶和华面前 、 盛无酵饼的筐子里取出一个无酵饼，一个油饼，一个薄饼，都放在脂油和右腿上，
8.en: Then from the basket of bread made without yeast, which was before the Lord , he took a cake of bread, and one made with oil, and a wafer; he put these on the fat portions and on the right thigh.

8.zh: 把这一切放在亚伦的手上和他儿子的手上作摇祭，在耶和华面前摇一摇。
8.en: He put all these in the hands of Aaron and his sons and waved them before the Lord as a wave offering.

8.zh: 摩西从他们的手上拿下来，烧在坛上的燔祭上，都是为承接圣职献给耶和华馨香的火祭。
8.en: Then Moses took them from their hands and burned them on the altar on top of the burnt offering as an ordination offering, a pleasing aroma, an offering made to the Lord by fire.

8.zh: 摩西拿羊的胸作为摇祭，在耶和华面前摇一摇，是承接圣职之礼，归摩西的分，都是照耶和华所吩咐摩西的。
8.en: He also took the breast-Moses' share of the ordination ram-and waved it before the Lord as a wave offering, as the Lord commanded Moses.

8.zh: 摩西取点膏油和坛上的血，弹在亚伦和他的衣服上，并他儿子和他儿子的衣服上，使他和他们的衣服一同成圣。
8.en: Then Moses took some of the anointing oil and some of the blood from the altar and sprinkled them on Aaron and his garments and on his sons and their garments. So he consecrated Aaron and his garments and his sons and their garments.

8.zh: 摩西对亚伦和他儿子说：把肉煮在会幕门口，在那里吃，又吃承接圣职筐子里的饼，按我所吩咐的说（或作：按所吩咐我的说）：这是亚伦和他儿子要吃的。
8.en: Moses then said to Aaron and his sons, "Cook the meat at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting and eat it there with the bread from the basket of ordination offerings, as I commanded, saying, 'Aaron and his sons are to eat it.'

8.zh: 剩下的肉和饼，你们要用火焚烧。
8.en: Then burn up the rest of the meat and the bread.

8.zh: 你们七天不可出会幕的门，等到你们承接圣职的日子满了，因为主叫你们七天承接圣职。
8.en: Do not leave the entrance to the Tent of Meeting for seven days, until the days of your ordination are completed, for your ordination will last seven days.

8.zh: 像今天所行的都是耶和华吩咐行的，为你们赎罪。
8.en: What has been done today was commanded by the Lord to make atonement for you.

8.zh: 七天你们要昼夜住在会幕门口，遵守耶和华的吩咐，免得你们死亡，因为所吩咐我的就是这样。
8.en: You must stay at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting day and night for seven days and do what the Lord requires, so you will not die; for that is what I have been commanded."

8.zh: 于是亚伦和他儿子行了耶和华藉著摩西所吩咐的一切事。
8.en: So Aaron and his sons did everything the Lord commanded through Moses.

9.zh: 到了第八天，摩西召了亚伦和他儿子，并以色列的众长老来，
9.en: On the eighth day Moses summonedAaron and his sons and the elders of Israel.

9.zh: 对亚伦说：你当取牛群中的一只公牛犊作赎罪祭，一只公绵羊作燔祭，都要没有残疾的，献在耶和华面前。
9.en: He said to Aaron, "Take a bull calf for your sin offering and a ram for your burnt offering, both without defect, and present them before the Lord .

9.zh: 你也要对以色列人说：你们当取一只公山羊作赎罪祭，又取一只牛犊和一只绵羊羔，都要一岁 、 没有残疾的，作燔祭，
9.en: Then say to the Israelites: 'Take a male goat for a sin offering, a calf and a lamb-both a year old and without defect-for a burnt offering,

9.zh: 又取一只公牛，一只公绵羊作平安祭，献在耶和华面前，并取调油的素祭，因为今天耶和华要向你们显现。
9.en: and an ox and a ram for a fellowship offering to sacrifice before the Lord , together with a grain offering mixed with oil. For today the Lord will appear to you.' "

9.zh: 于是他们把摩西所吩咐的，带到会幕前；全会众都近前来，站在耶和华面前。
9.en: They took the things Moses commanded to the front of the Tent of Meeting, and the entire assembly came near and stood before the Lord .

9.zh: 摩西说：这是耶和华吩咐你们所当行的；耶和华的荣光就要向你们显现。
9.en: Then Moses said, "This is what the Lord has commanded you to do, so that the glory of the Lord may appear to you."

9.zh: 摩西对亚伦说：你就近坛前，献你的赎罪祭和燔祭，为自己与百姓赎罪，又献上百姓的供物，为他们赎罪，都照耶和华所吩咐的。
9.en: Moses said to Aaron, "Come to the altar and sacrifice your sin offering and your burnt offering and make atonement for yourself and the people; sacrifice the offering that is for the people and make atonement for them, as the Lord has commanded."

9.zh: 于是，亚伦就近坛前，宰了为自己作赎罪祭的牛犊。
9.en: So Aaron came to the altar and slaughtered the calf as a sin offering for himself.

9.zh: 亚伦的儿子把血奉给他，他就把指头蘸在血中，抹在坛的四角上，又把血倒在坛脚那里。
9.en: His sons brought the blood to him, and he dipped his finger into the blood and put it on the horns of the altar; the rest of the blood he poured out at the base of the altar.

9.zh: 惟有赎罪祭的脂油和腰子，并肝上取的网子，都烧在坛上，是照耶和华所吩咐摩西的；
9.en: On the altar he burned the fat, the kidneys and the covering of the liver from the sin offering, as the Lord commanded Moses;

9.zh: 又用火将肉和皮烧在营外。
9.en: the flesh and the hide he burned up outside the camp.

9.zh: 亚伦宰了燔祭牲，他儿子把血递给他，他就洒在坛的周围，
9.en: Then he slaughtered the burnt offering. His sons handed him the blood, and he sprinkled it against the altar on all sides.

9.zh: 又把燔祭一块一块的 、 连头递给他，他都烧在坛上；
9.en: They handed him the burnt offering piece by piece, including the head, and he burned them on the altar.

9.zh: 又洗了脏腑和腿，烧在坛上的燔祭上。
9.en: He washed the inner parts and the legs and burned them on top of the burnt offering on the altar.

9.zh: 他奉上百姓的供物，把那给百姓作赎罪祭的公山羊宰了，为罪献上，和先献的一样；
9.en: Aaron then brought the offering that was for the people. He took the goat for the people's sin offering and slaughtered it and offered it for a sin offering as he did with the first one.

9.zh: 也奉上燔祭，照例而献。
9.en: He brought the burnt offering and offered it in the prescribed way.

9.zh: 他又奉上素祭，从其中取一满把，烧在坛上；这是在早晨的燔祭以外。
9.en: He also brought the grain offering, took a handful of it and burned it on the altar in addition to the morning's burnt offering.

9.zh: 亚伦宰了那给百姓作平安祭的公牛和公绵羊。他儿子把血递给他，他就洒在坛的周围；
9.en: He slaughtered the ox and the ram as the fellowship offering for the people. His sons handed him the blood, and he sprinkled it against the altar on all sides.

9.zh: 又把公牛和公绵羊的脂油 、 肥尾巴，并盖脏的脂油与腰子，和肝上的网子，都递给他；
9.en: But the fat portions of the ox and the ram-the fat tail, the layer of fat, the kidneys and the covering of the liver-

9.zh: 把脂油放在胸上，他就把脂油烧在坛上。
9.en: these they laid on the breasts, and then Aaron burned the fat on the altar.

9.zh: 胸和右腿，亚伦当作摇祭，在耶和华面前摇一摇，都是照摩西所吩咐的。
9.en: Aaron waved the breasts and the right thigh before the Lord as a wave offering, as Moses commanded.

9.zh: 亚伦向百姓举手，为他们祝福。他献了赎罪祭 、 燔祭 、 平安祭就下来了。
9.en: Then Aaron lifted his hands toward the people and blessed them. And having sacrificed the sin offering, the burnt offering and the fellowship offering, he stepped down.

9.zh: 摩西 、 亚伦进入会幕，又出来为百姓祝福，耶和华的荣光就向众民显现。
9.en: Moses and Aaron then went into the Tent of Meeting. When they came out, they blessed the people; and the glory of the Lord appeared to all the people.

9.zh: 有火从耶和华面前出来，在坛上烧尽燔祭和脂油；众民一见，就都欢呼，俯伏在地。
9.en: Fire came out from the presence of the Lord and consumed the burnt offering and the fat portions on the altar. And when all the people saw it, they shouted for joy and fell facedown.

10.zh: 亚伦的儿子拿答 、 亚比户各拿自己的香炉，盛上火，加上香，在耶和华面前献上凡火，是耶和华没有吩咐他们的，
10.en: Aaron's sons Nadab and Abihu took their censers, put fire in them and added incense; and they offered unauthorized fire before the Lord , contrary to his command.

10.zh: 就有火从耶和华面前出来，把他们烧灭，他们就死在耶和华面前。
10.en: So fire came out from the presence of the Lord and consumed them, and they died before the Lord .

10.zh: 于是摩西对亚伦说：这就是耶和华所说：我在亲近我的人中要显为圣；在众民面前，我要得荣耀。亚伦就默默不言。
10.en: Moses then said to Aaron, "This is what the Lord spoke of when he said: " 'Among those who approach me I will show myself holy; in the sight of all the people I will be honored.' " Aaron remained silent.

10.zh: 摩西召了亚伦叔父乌薛的儿子米沙利 、 以利撒反来，对他们说：上前来，把你们的亲属从圣所前抬到营外。
10.en: Moses summoned Mishael and Elzaphan, sons of Aaron's uncle Uzziel, and said to them, "Come here; carry your cousins outside the camp, away from the front of the sanctuary."

10.zh: 于是二人上前来，把他们穿著袍子抬到营外，是照摩西所吩咐的。
10.en: So they came and carried them, still in their tunics, outside the camp, as Moses ordered.

10.zh: 摩西对亚伦和他儿子以利亚撒 、 以他玛说：不可蓬头散发，也不可撕裂衣裳，免得你们死亡，又免得耶和华向会众发怒；只要你们的弟兄以色列全家为耶和华所发的火哀哭。
10.en: Then Moses said to Aaron and his sons Eleazar and Ithamar, "Do not let your hair become unkempt, and do not tear your clothes, or you will die and the Lord will be angry with the whole community. But your relatives, all the house of Israel, may mourn for those the Lord has destroyed by fire.

10.zh: 你们也不可出会幕的门，恐怕你们死亡，因为耶和华的膏油在你们的身上。他们就照摩西的话行了。
10.en: Do not leave the entrance to the Tent of Meeting or you will die, because the Lord 's anointing oil is on you." So they did as Moses said.

10.zh: 耶和华晓谕亚伦说：
10.en: Then the Lord said to Aaron,

10.zh: 你和你儿子进会幕的时候，清酒 、 浓酒都不可喝，免得你们死亡；这要作你们世世代代永远的定例。
10.en: "You and your sons are not to drink wine or other fermented drink whenever you go into the Tent of Meeting, or you will die. This is a lasting ordinance for the generations to come.

10.zh: 使你们可以将圣的 、 俗的，洁净的 、 不洁净的，分别出来；
10.en: You must distinguish between the holy and the common, between the unclean and the clean,

10.zh: 又使你们可以将耶和华藉摩西晓谕以色列人的一切律例教训他们。
10.en: and you must teach the Israelites all the decrees the Lord has given them through Moses."

10.zh: 摩西对亚伦和他剩下的儿子以利亚撒 、 以他玛说：你们献给耶和华火祭中所剩的素祭，要在坛旁不带酵而吃，因为是至圣的。
10.en: Moses said to Aaron and his remaining sons, Eleazar and Ithamar, "Take the grain offering left over from the offerings made to the Lord by fire and eat it prepared without yeast beside the altar, for it is most holy.

10.zh: 你们要在圣处吃；因为在献给耶和华的火祭中，这是你的分和你儿子的分；所吩咐我的本是这样。
10.en: Eat it in a holy place, because it is your share and your sons' share of the offerings made to the Lord by fire; for so I have been commanded.

10.zh: 所摇的胸，所举的腿，你们要在洁净地方吃。你和你的儿女都要同吃；因为这些是从以色列人平安祭中给你，当你的分和你儿子的分。
10.en: But you and your sons and your daughters may eat the breast that was waved and the thigh that was presented. Eat them in a ceremonially clean place; they have been given to you and your children as your share of the Israelites' fellowship offerings.

10.zh: 所举的腿，所摇的胸，他们要与火祭的脂油一同带来当摇祭，在耶和华面前摇一摇；这要归你和你儿子，当作永得的分，都是照耶和华所吩咐的。
10.en: The thigh that was presented and the breast that was waved must be brought with the fat portions of the offerings made by fire, to be waved before the Lord as a wave offering. This will be the regular share for you and your children, as the Lord has commanded."

10.zh: 当下摩西急切的寻找作赎罪祭的公山羊，谁知已经焚烧了，便向亚伦剩下的儿子以利亚撒 、 以他玛发怒，说：
10.en: When Moses inquired about the goat of the sin offering and found that it had been burned up, he was angry with Eleazar and Ithamar, Aaron's remaining sons, and asked,

10.zh: 这赎罪祭既是至圣的，主又给了你们，为要你们担当会众的罪孽，在耶和华面前为他们赎罪，你们为何没有在圣所吃呢？
10.en: "Why didn't you eat the sin offering in the sanctuary area? It is most holy; it was given to you to take away the guilt of the community by making atonement for them before the Lord .

10.zh: 看哪，这祭牲的血并没有拿到圣所里去，你们本当照我所吩咐的，在圣所里吃这祭肉。
10.en: Since its blood was not taken into the Holy Place, you should have eaten the goat in the sanctuary area, as I commanded."

10.zh: 亚伦对摩西说：今天他们在耶和华面前献上赎罪祭和燔祭，我又遇见这样的灾，若今天吃了赎罪祭，耶和华岂能看为美呢？
10.en: Aaron replied to Moses, "Today they sacrificed their sin offering and their burnt offering before the Lord , but such things as this have happened to me. Would the Lord have been pleased if I had eaten the sin offering today?"

10.zh: 摩西听见这话，便以为美。
10.en: When Moses heard this, he was satisfied.

11.zh: 耶和华对摩西 、 亚伦说：
11.en: The Lord said to Moses and Aaron,

11.zh: 你们晓谕以色列人说，在地上一切走兽中可吃的乃是这些：
11.en: "Say to the Israelites: 'Of all the animals that live on land, these are the ones you may eat:

11.zh: 凡蹄分两瓣 、 倒嚼的走兽，你们都可以吃。
11.en: You may eat any animal that has a split hoof completely divided and that chews the cud.

11.zh: 但那倒嚼或分蹄之中不可吃的乃是：骆驼 ─ 因为倒嚼不分蹄，就与你们不洁净；
11.en: " 'There are some that only chew the cud or only have a split hoof, but you must not eat them. The camel, though it chews the cud, does not have a split hoof; it is ceremonially unclean for you.

11.zh: 沙番 ─ 因为倒嚼不分蹄，就与你们不洁净；
11.en: The coney, though it chews the cud, does not have a split hoof; it is unclean for you.

11.zh: 兔子 ─ 因为倒嚼不分蹄，就与你们不洁净；
11.en: The rabbit, though it chews the cud, does not have a split hoof; it is unclean for you.

11.zh: 猪 ─ 因为蹄分两瓣，却不倒嚼，就与你们不洁净。
11.en: And the pig, though it has a split hoof completely divided, does not chew the cud; it is unclean for you.

11.zh: 这些兽的肉，你们不可吃；死的，你们不可摸，都与你们不洁净。
11.en: You must not eat their meat or touch their carcasses; they are unclean for you.

11.zh: 水中可吃的乃是这些：凡在水里 、 海里 、 河里 、 有翅有鳞的，都可以吃。
11.en: " 'Of all the creatures living in the water of the seas and the streams, you may eat any that have fins and scales.

11.zh: 凡在海里 、 河里，并一切水里游动的活物，无翅无鳞的，你们都当以为可憎。
11.en: But all creatures in the seas or streams that do not have fins and scales -whether among all the swarming things or among all the other living creatures in the water-you are to detest.

11.zh: 这些无翅无鳞 、 以为可憎的，你们不可吃他的肉；死的也当以为可憎。
11.en: And since you are to detest them, you must not eat their meat and you must detest their carcasses.

11.zh: 凡水里无翅无鳞的，你们都当以为可憎。
11.en: Anything living in the water that does not have fins and scales is to be detestable to you.

11.zh: 雀鸟中你们当以为可憎 、 不可吃的乃是：雕 、 狗头雕 、 红头雕 、
11.en: " 'These are the birds you are to detest and not eat because they are detestable: the eagle, the vulture, the black vulture,

11.zh: 鹞鹰 、 小鹰与其类；
11.en: the red kite, any kind of black kite,

11.zh: 乌鸦与其类；
11.en: any kind of raven,

11.zh: 鸵鸟 、 夜鹰 、 鱼鹰 、 鹰与其类；
11.en: the horned owl, the screech owl, the gull, any kind of hawk,

11.zh: 鸮鸟 、 鸬鹚 、 猫头鹰 、
11.en: the little owl, the cormorant, the great owl,

11.zh: 角鸱 、 鹈鹕 、 秃雕 、
11.en: the white owl, the desert owl, the osprey,

11.zh: 鹳 、 鹭鸶与其类；戴鵀与蝙蝠。
11.en: the stork, any kind of heron, the hoopoe and the bat.

11.zh: 凡有翅膀用四足爬行的物，你们都当以为可憎。
11.en: " 'All flying insects that walk on all fours are to be detestable to you.

11.zh: 只是有翅膀用四足爬行的物中，有足有腿，在地上蹦跳的，你们还可以吃。
11.en: There are, however, some winged creatures that walk on all fours that you may eat: those that have jointed legs for hopping on the ground.

11.zh: 其中有蝗虫 、 蚂蚱 、 蟋蟀与其类；蚱蜢与其类；这些你们都可以吃。
11.en: Of these you may eat any kind of locust, katydid, cricket or grasshopper.

11.zh: 但是有翅膀有四足的爬物，你们都当以为可憎。
11.en: But all other winged creatures that have four legs you are to detest.

11.zh: 这些都能使你们不洁净。凡摸了死的，必不洁净到晚上。
11.en: " 'You will make yourselves unclean by these; whoever touches their carcasses will be unclean till evening.

11.zh: 凡拿了死的，必不洁净到晚上，并要洗衣服。
11.en: Whoever picks up one of their carcasses must wash his clothes, and he will be unclean till evening.

11.zh: 凡走兽分蹄不成两瓣 、 也不倒嚼的，是与你们不洁净；凡摸了的就不洁净。
11.en: " 'Every animal that has a split hoof not completely divided or that does not chew the cud is unclean for you; whoever touches the carcass of any of them will be unclean.

11.zh: 凡四足的走兽，用掌行走的，是与你们不洁净；摸其尸的，必不洁净到晚上。
11.en: Of all the animals that walk on all fours, those that walk on their paws are unclean for you; whoever touches their carcasses will be unclean till evening.

11.zh: 拿其尸的，必不洁净到晚上，并要洗衣服。这些是与你们不洁净的。
11.en: Anyone who picks up their carcasses must wash his clothes, and he will be unclean till evening. They are unclean for you.

11.zh: 地上爬物与你们不洁净的乃是这些：鼬鼠 、 鼫鼠 、 蜥蜴与其类；
11.en: " 'Of the animals that move about on the ground, these are unclean for you: the weasel, the rat, any kind of great lizard,

11.zh: 壁虎 、 龙子 、 守宫 、 蛇医 、 蝘蜓。
11.en: the gecko, the monitor lizard, the wall lizard, the skink and the chameleon.

11.zh: 这些爬物都是与你们不洁净的。在他死了以后，凡摸了的，必不洁净到晚上。
11.en: Of all those that move along the ground, these are unclean for you. Whoever touches them when they are dead will be unclean till evening.

11.zh: 其中死了的，掉在甚么东西上，这东西就不洁净，无论是木器 、 衣服 、 皮子 、 口袋，不拘是做甚么工用的器皿，须要放在水中，必不洁净到晚上，到晚上才洁净了。
11.en: When one of them dies and falls on something, that article, whatever its use, will be unclean, whether it is made of wood, cloth, hide or sackcloth. Put it in water; it will be unclean till evening, and then it will be clean.

11.zh: 若有死了掉在瓦器里的，其中不拘有甚么，就不洁净，你们要把这瓦器打破了。
11.en: If one of them falls into a clay pot, everything in it will be unclean, and you must break the pot.

11.zh: 其中一切可吃的食物，沾水的就不洁净，并且那样器皿中一切可喝的，也必不洁净。
11.en: Any food that could be eaten but has water on it from such a pot is unclean, and any liquid that could be drunk from it is unclean.

11.zh: 其中已死的，若有一点掉在甚么物件上，那物件就不洁净，不拘是炉子，是锅台，就要打碎，都不洁净，也必与你们不洁净。
11.en: Anything that one of their carcasses falls on becomes unclean; an oven or cooking pot must be broken up. They are unclean, and you are to regard them as unclean.

11.zh: 但是泉源或是聚水的池子仍是洁净；惟挨了那死的，就不洁净。
11.en: A spring, however, or a cistern for collecting water remains clean, but anyone who touches one of these carcasses is unclean.

11.zh: 若是死的，有一点掉在要种的子粒上，子粒仍是洁净；
11.en: If a carcass falls on any seeds that are to be planted, they remain clean.

11.zh: 若水已经浇在子粒上，那死的有一点掉在上头，这子粒就与你们不洁净。
11.en: But if water has been put on the seed and a carcass falls on it, it is unclean for you.

11.zh: 你们可吃的走兽若是死了，有人摸他，必不洁净到晚上；
11.en: " 'If an animal that you are allowed to eat dies, anyone who touches the carcass will be unclean till evening.

11.zh: 有人吃那死了的走兽，必不洁净到晚上，并要洗衣服；拿了死走兽的，必不洁净到晚上，并要洗衣服。
11.en: Anyone who eats some of the carcass must wash his clothes, and he will be unclean till evening. Anyone who picks up the carcass must wash his clothes, and he will be unclean till evening.

11.zh: 凡地上的爬物是可憎的，都不可吃。
11.en: " 'Every creature that moves about on the ground is detestable; it is not to be eaten.

11.zh: 凡用肚子行走的和用四足行走的，或是有许多足的，就是一切爬在地上的，你们都不可吃，因为是可憎的。
11.en: You are not to eat any creature that moves about on the ground, whether it moves on its belly or walks on all fours or on many feet; it is detestable.

11.zh: 你们不可因甚么爬物使自己成为可憎的，也不可因这些使自己不洁净，以致染了污秽。
11.en: Do not defile yourselves by any of these creatures. Do not make yourselves unclean by means of them or be made unclean by them.

11.zh: 我是耶和华 ─ 你们的神；所以你们要成为圣洁，因为我是圣洁的。你们也不可在地上的爬物污秽自己。
11.en: I am the Lord your God; consecrate yourselves and be holy, because I am holy. Do not make yourselves unclean by any creature that moves about on the ground.

11.zh: 我是把你们从埃及地领出来的耶和华，要作你们的神；所以你们要圣洁，因为我是圣洁的。
11.en: I am the Lord who brought you up out of Egypt to be your God; therefore be holy, because I am holy.

11.zh: 这是走兽 、 飞鸟，和水中游动的活物，并地上爬物的条例。
11.en: " 'These are the regulations concerning animals, birds, every living thing that moves in the water and every creature that moves about on the ground.

11.zh: 要把洁净的和不洁净的，可吃的与不可吃的活物，都分别出来。
11.en: You must distinguish between the unclean and the clean, between living creatures that may be eaten and those that may not be eaten.' "

12.zh: 你晓谕以色列人说：若有妇人怀孕生男孩，他就不洁净七天，像在月经污秽的日子不洁净一样。
12.en: "Say to the Israelites: 'A woman who becomes pregnant and gives birth to a son will be ceremonially unclean for seven days, just as she is unclean during her monthly period.

12.zh: 第八天，要给婴孩行割礼。
12.en: On the eighth day the boy is to be circumcised.

12.zh: 妇人在产血不洁之中，要家居三十三天。他洁净的日子未满，不可摸圣物，也不可进入圣所。
12.en: Then the woman must wait thirty-three days to be purified from her bleeding. She must not touch anything sacred or go to the sanctuary until the days of her purification are over.

12.zh: 他若生女孩，就不洁净两个七天，像污秽的时候一样，要在产血不洁之中，家居六十六天。
12.en: If she gives birth to a daughter, for two weeks the woman will be unclean, as during her period. Then she must wait sixty-six days to be purified from her bleeding.

12.zh: 满了洁净的日子，无论是为男孩是为女孩，他要把一岁的羊羔为燔祭，一只雏鸽或是一只斑鸠为赎罪祭，带到会幕门口交给祭司。
12.en: " 'When the days of her purification for a son or daughter are over, she is to bring to the priest at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting a year-old lamb for a burnt offering and a young pigeon or a dove for a sin offering.

12.zh: 祭司要献在耶和华面前，为他赎罪，他的血源就洁净了。这条例是为生育的妇人，无论是生男生女。
12.en: He shall offer them before the Lord to make atonement for her, and then she will be ceremonially clean from her flow of blood. " 'These are the regulations for the woman who gives birth to a boy or a girl.

12.zh: 他的力量不够献一只羊羔，他就要取两只斑鸠或是两只雏鸽，一只为燔祭，一只为赎罪祭。祭司要为他赎罪，他就洁净了。
12.en: If she cannot afford a lamb, she is to bring two doves or two young pigeons, one for a burnt offering and the other for a sin offering. In this way the priest will make atonement for her, and she will be clean.' "

13.zh: 耶和华晓谕摩西 、 亚伦说：
13.en: The Lord said to Moses andAaron,

13.zh: 人的肉皮上若长了疖子，或长了癣，或长了火斑，在他肉皮上成了大痳疯的灾病，就要将他带到祭司亚伦或亚伦作祭司的一个子孙面前。
13.en: "When anyone has a swelling or a rash or a bright spot on his skin that may become an infectious skin disease, he must be brought to Aaron the priest or to one of his sons who is a priest.

13.zh: 祭司要察看肉皮上的灾病，若灾病处的毛已经变白，灾病的现象深于肉上的皮，这便是大痳疯的灾病。祭司要察看他，定他为不洁净。
13.en: The priest is to examine the sore on his skin, and if the hair in the sore has turned white and the sore appears to be more than skin deep, it is an infectious skin disease. When the priest examines him, he shall pronounce him ceremonially unclean.

13.zh: 若火斑在他肉皮上是白的，现象不深于皮，其上的毛也没有变白，祭司就要将有灾病的人关锁七天。
13.en: If the spot on his skin is white but does not appear to be more than skin deep and the hair in it has not turned white, the priest is to put the infected person in isolation for seven days.

13.zh: 第七天，祭司要察看他，若看灾病止住了，没有在皮上发散，祭司还要将他关锁七天。
13.en: On the seventh day the priest is to examine him, and if he sees that the sore is unchanged and has not spread in the skin, he is to keep him in isolation another seven days.

13.zh: 第七天，祭司要再察看他，若灾病发暗，而且没有在皮上发散，祭司要定他为洁净，原来是癣；那人就要洗衣服，得为洁净。
13.en: On the seventh day the priest is to examine him again, and if the sore has faded and has not spread in the skin, the priest shall pronounce him clean; it is only a rash. The man must wash his clothes, and he will be clean.

13.zh: 但他为得洁净，将身体给祭司察看以后，癣若在皮上发散开了，他要再将身体给祭司察看。
13.en: But if the rash does spread in his skin after he has shown himself to the priest to be pronounced clean, he must appear before the priest again.

13.zh: 祭司要察看，癣若在皮上发散，就要定他为不洁净，是大痳疯。
13.en: The priest is to examine him, and if the rash has spread in the skin, he shall pronounce him unclean; it is an infectious disease.

13.zh: 人有了大痳疯的灾病，就要将他带到祭司面前。
13.en: "When anyone has an infectious skin disease, he must be brought to the priest.

13.zh: 祭司要察看，皮上若长了白疖，使毛变白，在长白疖之处有了红瘀肉，
13.en: The priest is to examine him, and if there is a white swelling in the skin that has turned the hair white and if there is raw flesh in the swelling,

13.zh: 这是肉皮上的旧大痳疯，祭司要定他为不洁净，不用将他关锁，因为他是不洁净了。
13.en: it is a chronic skin disease and the priest shall pronounce him unclean. He is not to put him in isolation, because he is already unclean.

13.zh: 大痳疯若在皮上四外发散，长满了患灾病人的皮，据祭司察看，从头到脚无处不有，
13.en: "If the disease breaks out all over his skin and, so far as the priest can see, it covers all the skin of the infected person from head to foot,

13.zh: 祭司就要察看，全身的肉若长满了大痳疯，就要定那患灾病的为洁净；全身都变为白，他乃洁净了。
13.en: the priest is to examine him, and if the disease has covered his whole body, he shall pronounce that person clean. Since it has all turned white, he is clean.

13.zh: 但红肉几时显在他的身上就几时不洁净。
13.en: But whenever raw flesh appears on him, he will be unclean.

13.zh: 祭司一看那红肉就定他为不洁净。红肉本是不洁净，是大痳疯。
13.en: When the priest sees the raw flesh, he shall pronounce him unclean. The raw flesh is unclean; he has an infectious disease.

13.zh: 红肉若复原，又变白了，他就要来见祭司。
13.en: Should the raw flesh change and turn white, he must go to the priest.

13.zh: 祭司要察看，灾病处若变白了，祭司就要定那患灾病的为洁净，他乃洁净了。
13.en: The priest is to examine him, and if the sores have turned white, the priest shall pronounce the infected person clean; then he will be clean.

13.zh: 人若在皮肉上长疮，却治好了，
13.en: "When someone has a boil on his skin and it heals,

13.zh: 在长疮之处又起了白疖，或是白中带红的火斑，就要给祭司察看。
13.en: and in the place where the boil was, a white swelling or reddish-white spot appears, he must present himself to the priest.

13.zh: 祭司要察看，若现象洼于皮，其上的毛也变白了，就要定他为不洁净，是大痳疯的灾病发在疮中。
13.en: The priest is to examine it, and if it appears to be more than skin deep and the hair in it has turned white, the priest shall pronounce him unclean. It is an infectious skin disease that has broken out where the boil was.

13.zh: 祭司若察看，其上没有白毛，也没有洼于皮，乃是发暗，就要将他关锁七天。
13.en: But if, when the priest examines it, there is no white hair in it and it is not more than skin deep and has faded, then the priest is to put him in isolation for seven days.

13.zh: 若在皮上发散开了，祭司就要定他为不洁净，是灾病。
13.en: If it is spreading in the skin, the priest shall pronounce him unclean; it is infectious.

13.zh: 火斑若在原处止住，没有发散，便是疮的痕迹，祭司就要定他为洁净。
13.en: But if the spot is unchanged and has not spread, it is only a scar from the boil, and the priest shall pronounce him clean.

13.zh: 人的皮肉上若起了火毒，火毒的瘀肉成了火斑，或是白中带红的，或是全白的，
13.en: "When someone has a burn on his skin and a reddish-white or white spot appears in the raw flesh of the burn,

13.zh: 祭司就要察看，火斑中的毛若变白了，现象又深于皮，是大痳疯在火毒中发出，就要定他为不洁净，是大痳疯的灾病。
13.en: the priest is to examine the spot, and if the hair in it has turned white, and it appears to be more than skin deep, it is an infectious disease that has broken out in the burn. The priest shall pronounce him unclean; it is an infectious skin disease.

13.zh: 但是祭司察看，在火斑中若没有白毛，也没有洼于皮，乃是发暗，就要将他关锁七天。
13.en: But if the priest examines it and there is no white hair in the spot and if it is not more than skin deep and has faded, then the priest is to put him in isolation for seven days.

13.zh: 到第七天，祭司要察看他，火斑若在皮上发散开了，就要定他为不洁净，是大痳疯的灾病。
13.en: On the seventh day the priest is to examine him, and if it is spreading in the skin, the priest shall pronounce him unclean; it is an infectious skin disease.

13.zh: 火斑若在原处止住，没有在皮上发散，乃是发暗，是起的火毒，祭司要定他为洁净，不过是火毒的痕迹。
13.en: If, however, the spot is unchanged and has not spread in the skin but has faded, it is a swelling from the burn, and the priest shall pronounce him clean; it is only a scar from the burn.

13.zh: 无论男女，若在头上有灾病，或是男人胡须上有灾病，
13.en: "If a man or woman has a sore on the head or on the chin,

13.zh: 祭司就要察看；这灾病现象若深于皮，其间有细黄毛，就要定他为不洁净，这是头疥，是头上或是胡须上的大痳疯。
13.en: the priest is to examine the sore, and if it appears to be more than skin deep and the hair in it is yellow and thin, the priest shall pronounce that person unclean; it is an itch, an infectious disease of the head or chin.

13.zh: 祭司若察看头疥的灾病，现象不深于皮，其间也没有黑毛，就要将长头疥灾病的关锁七天。
13.en: But if, when the priest examines this kind of sore, it does not seem to be more than skin deep and there is no black hair in it, then the priest is to put the infected person in isolation for seven days.

13.zh: 第七天，祭司要察看灾病，若头疥没有发散，其间也没有黄毛，头疥的现象不深于皮，
13.en: On the seventh day the priest is to examine the sore, and if the itch has not spread and there is no yellow hair in it and it does not appear to be more than skin deep,

13.zh: 那人就要剃去须发，但他不可剃头疥之处。祭司要将那长头疥的，再关锁七天。
13.en: he must be shaved except for the diseased area, and the priest is to keep him in isolation another seven days.

13.zh: 第七天，祭司要察看头疥，头疥若没有在皮上发散，现象也不深于皮，就要定他为洁净，他要洗衣服，便成为洁净。
13.en: On the seventh day the priest is to examine the itch, and if it has not spread in the skin and appears to be no more than skin deep, the priest shall pronounce him clean. He must wash his clothes, and he will be clean.

13.zh: 但他得洁净以后，头疥若在皮上发散开了，
13.en: But if the itch does spread in the skin after he is pronounced clean,

13.zh: 祭司就要察看他。头疥若在皮上发散，就不必找那黄毛，他是不洁净了。
13.en: the priest is to examine him, and if the itch has spread in the skin, the priest does not need to look for yellow hair; the person is unclean.

13.zh: 祭司若看头疥已经止住，其间也长了黑毛，头疥已然痊愈，那人是洁净了，就要定他为洁净。
13.en: If, however, in his judgment it is unchanged and black hair has grown in it, the itch is healed. He is clean, and the priest shall pronounce him clean.

13.zh: 无论男女，皮肉上若起了火斑，就是白火斑，
13.en: "When a man or woman has white spots on the skin,

13.zh: 祭司就要察看，他们肉皮上的火斑若白中带黑，这是皮上发出的白癣，那人是洁净了。
13.en: the priest is to examine them, and if the spots are dull white, it is a harmless rash that has broken out on the skin; that person is clean.

13.zh: 人头上的发若掉了，他不过是头秃，还是洁净。
13.en: "When a man has lost his hair and is bald, he is clean.

13.zh: 他顶前若掉了头发，他不过是顶门秃，还是洁净。
13.en: If he has lost his hair from the front of his scalp and has a bald forehead, he is clean.

13.zh: 头秃处或是顶门秃处若有白中带红的灾病，这就是大痳疯发在他头秃处或是顶门秃处，
13.en: But if he has a reddish-white sore on his bald head or forehead, it is an infectious disease breaking out on his head or forehead.

13.zh: 祭司就要察看，他起的那灾病若在头秃处或是顶门秃处有白中带红的，像肉皮上大痳疯的现象，
13.en: The priest is to examine him, and if the swollen sore on his head or forehead is reddish-white like an infectious skin disease,

13.zh: 那人就是长大痳疯，不洁净的，祭司总要定他为不洁净，他的灾病是在头上。
13.en: the man is diseased and is unclean. The priest shall pronounce him unclean because of the sore on his head.

13.zh: 身上有长大痳疯灾病的，他的衣服要撕裂，也要蓬头散发，蒙著上唇，喊叫说：不洁净了！不洁净了！
13.en: "The person with such an infectious disease must wear torn clothes, let his hair be unkempt, cover the lower part of his face and cry out, 'Unclean! Unclean!'

13.zh: 灾病在他身上的日子，他便是不洁净；他既是不洁净，就要独居营外。
13.en: As long as he has the infection he remains unclean. He must live alone; he must live outside the camp.

13.zh: 染了大痳疯灾病的衣服，无论是羊毛衣服 、 是麻布衣服，
13.en: "If any clothing is contaminated with mildew-any woolen or linen clothing,

13.zh: 无论是在经上 、 在纬上，是麻布的 、 是羊毛的，是在皮子上，或在皮子做的甚么物件上，
13.en: any woven or knitted material of linen or wool, any leather or anything made of leather-

13.zh: 或在衣服上 、 皮子上，经上 、 纬上，或在皮子做的甚么物件上，这灾病若是发绿，或是发红，是大痳疯的灾病，要给祭司察看。
13.en: and if the contamination in the clothing, or leather, or woven or knitted material, or any leather article, is greenish or reddish, it is a spreading mildew and must be shown to the priest.

13.zh: 祭司就要察看那灾病，把染了灾病的物件关锁七天。
13.en: The priest is to examine the mildew and isolate the affected article for seven days.

13.zh: 第七天，他要察看那灾病，灾病或在衣服上，经上 、 纬上，皮子上，若发散，这皮子无论当作何用，这灾病是蚕食的大痳疯，都是不洁净了。
13.en: On the seventh day he is to examine it, and if the mildew has spread in the clothing, or the woven or knitted material, or the leather, whatever its use, it is a destructive mildew; the article is unclean.

13.zh: 那染了灾病的衣服，或是经上 、 纬上，羊毛上，麻衣上，或是皮子做的甚么物件上，他都要焚烧；因为这是蚕食的大痳疯，必在火中焚烧。
13.en: He must burn up the clothing, or the woven or knitted material of wool or linen, or any leather article that has the contamination in it, because the mildew is destructive; the article must be burned up.

13.zh: 祭司要察看，若灾病在衣服上，经上 、 纬上，或是皮子做的甚么物件上，没有发散，
13.en: "But if, when the priest examines it, the mildew has not spread in the clothing, or the woven or knitted material, or the leather article,

13.zh: 祭司就要吩咐他们，把染了灾病的物件洗了，再关锁七天。
13.en: he shall order that the contaminated article be washed. Then he is to isolate it for another seven days.

13.zh: 洗过以后，祭司要察看，那物件若没有变色，灾病也没有消散，那物件就不洁净，是透重的灾病，无论正面反面，都要在火中焚烧。
13.en: After the affected article has been washed, the priest is to examine it, and if the mildew has not changed its appearance, even though it has not spread, it is unclean. Burn it with fire, whether the mildew has affected one side or the other.

13.zh: 洗过以后，祭司要察看，若见那灾病发暗，他就要把那灾病从衣服上 、 皮子上 、 经上 、 纬上，都撕去。
13.en: If, when the priest examines it, the mildew has faded after the article has been washed, he is to tear the contaminated part out of the clothing, or the leather, or the woven or knitted material.

13.zh: 若仍现在衣服上，或是经上 、 纬上 、 皮子做的甚么物件上，这就是灾病又发了 、 必用火焚烧那染灾病的物件。
13.en: But if it reappears in the clothing, or in the woven or knitted material, or in the leather article, it is spreading, and whatever has the mildew must be burned with fire.

13.zh: 所洗的衣服，或是经，或是纬，或是皮子做的甚么物件，若灾病离开了，要再洗，就洁净了。
13.en: The clothing, or the woven or knitted material, or any leather article that has been washed and is rid of the mildew, must be washed again, and it will be clean."

13.zh: 这就是大痳疯灾病的条例，无论是在羊毛衣服上，麻布衣服上，经上 、 纬上，和皮子做的甚么物件上，可以定为洁净或是不洁净。
13.en: These are the regulations concerning contamination by mildew in woolen or linen clothing, woven or knitted material, or any leather article, for pronouncing them clean or unclean.

14.zh: 耶和华晓谕摩西说：
14.en: The Lord said to Moses,

14.zh: 长大痳疯得洁净的日子，其例乃是这样：要带他去见祭司；
14.en: "These are the regulations for the diseased person at the time of his ceremonial cleansing, when he is brought to the priest:

14.zh: 祭司要出到营外察看，若见他的大痳疯痊愈了
14.en: The priest is to go outside the camp and examine him. If the person has been healed of his infectious skin disease,

14.zh: 就要吩咐人为那求洁净的拿两只洁净的活鸟和香柏木 、 朱红色线，并牛膝草来。
14.en: the priest shall order that two live clean birds and some cedar wood, scarlet yarn and hyssop be brought for the one to be cleansed.

14.zh: 祭司要吩咐用瓦器盛活水，把一只鸟宰在上面。
14.en: Then the priest shall order that one of the birds be killed over fresh water in a clay pot.

14.zh: 至于那只活鸟，祭司要把他和香柏木 、 朱红色线并牛膝草一同蘸于宰在活水上的鸟血中，
14.en: He is then to take the live bird and dip it, together with the cedar wood, the scarlet yarn and the hyssop, into the blood of the bird that was killed over the fresh water.

14.zh: 用以在那长大痳疯求洁净的人身上洒七次，就定他为洁净，又把活鸟放在田野里。
14.en: Seven times he shall sprinkle the one to be cleansed of the infectious disease and pronounce him clean. Then he is to release the live bird in the open fields.

14.zh: 求洁净的人当洗衣服，剃去毛发，用水洗澡，就洁净了；然后可以进营，只是要在自己的帐棚外居住七天。
14.en: "The person to be cleansed must wash his clothes, shave off all his hair and bathe with water; then he will be ceremonially clean. After this he may come into the camp, but he must stay outside his tent for seven days.

14.zh: 第七天，再把头上所有的头发与胡须 、 眉毛，并全身的毛，都剃了；又要洗衣服，用水洗身，就洁净了。
14.en: On the seventh day he must shave off all his hair; he must shave his head, his beard, his eyebrows and the rest of his hair. He must wash his clothes and bathe himself with water, and he will be clean.

14.zh: 第八天，他要取两只没有残疾的公羊羔和一只没有残疾 、 一岁的母羊羔，又要把调油的细面伊法十分之三为素祭，并油一罗革，一同取来。
14.en: "On the eighth day he must bring two male lambs and one ewe lamb a year old, each without defect, along with three-tenths of an ephah of fine flour mixed with oil for a grain offering, and one log of oil.

14.zh: 行洁净之礼的祭司要将那求洁净的人和这些东西安置在会幕门口 、 耶和华面前。
14.en: The priest who pronounces him clean shall present both the one to be cleansed and his offerings before the Lord at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting.

14.zh: 祭司要取一只公羊羔献为赎愆祭，和那一罗革油一同作摇祭，在耶和华面前摇一摇；
14.en: "Then the priest is to take one of the male lambs and offer it as a guilt offering, along with the log of oil; he shall wave them before the Lord as a wave offering.

14.zh: 把公羊羔宰于圣地，就是宰赎罪祭牲和燔祭牲之地。赎愆祭要归祭司，与赎罪祭一样，是至圣的。
14.en: He is to slaughter the lamb in the holy place where the sin offering and the burnt offering are slaughtered. Like the sin offering, the guilt offering belongs to the priest; it is most holy.

14.zh: 祭司要取些赎愆祭牲的血，抹在求洁净人的右耳垂上和右手的大拇指上，并右脚的大拇指上。
14.en: The priest is to take some of the blood of the guilt offering and put it on the lobe of the right ear of the one to be cleansed, on the thumb of his right hand and on the big toe of his right foot.

14.zh: 祭司要从那一罗革油中取些倒在自己的左手掌里，
14.en: The priest shall then take some of the log of oil, pour it in the palm of his own left hand,

14.zh: 把右手的一个指头蘸在左手的油里，在耶和华面前用指头弹七次。
14.en: dip his right forefinger into the oil in his palm, and with his finger sprinkle some of it before the Lord seven times.

14.zh: 将手里所剩的油抹在那求洁净人的右耳垂上和右手的大拇指上，并右脚的大拇指上，就是抹在赎愆祭牲的血上。
14.en: The priest is to put some of the oil remaining in his palm on the lobe of the right ear of the one to be cleansed, on the thumb of his right hand and on the big toe of his right foot, on top of the blood of the guilt offering.

14.zh: 祭司手里所剩的油要抹在那求洁净人的头上，在耶和华面前为他赎罪。
14.en: The rest of the oil in his palm the priest shall put on the head of the one to be cleansed and make atonement for him before the Lord .

14.zh: 祭司要献赎罪祭，为那本不洁净 、 求洁净的人赎罪；然后要宰燔祭牲，
14.en: "Then the priest is to sacrifice the sin offering and make atonement for the one to be cleansed from his uncleanness. After that, the priest shall slaughter the burnt offering

14.zh: 把燔祭和素祭献在坛上，为他赎罪，他就洁净了。
14.en: and offer it on the altar, together with the grain offering, and make atonement for him, and he will be clean.

14.zh: 他若贫穷不能预备够数，就要取一只公羊羔作赎愆祭，可以摇一摇，为他赎罪；也要把调油的细面伊法十分之一为素祭，和油一罗革一同取来；
14.en: "If, however, he is poor and cannot afford these, he must take one male lamb as a guilt offering to be waved to make atonement for him, together with a tenth of an ephah of fine flour mixed with oil for a grain offering, a log of oil,

14.zh: 又照他的力量取两只斑鸠或是两只雏鸽，一只作赎罪祭，一只作燔祭。
14.en: and two doves or two young pigeons, which he can afford, one for a sin offering and the other for a burnt offering.

14.zh: 第八天，要为洁净，把这些带到会幕门口 、 耶和华面前，交给祭司。
14.en: "On the eighth day he must bring them for his cleansing to the priest at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting, before the Lord .

14.zh: 祭司要把赎愆祭的羊羔和那一罗革油一同作摇祭，在耶和华面前摇一摇。
14.en: The priest is to take the lamb for the guilt offering, together with the log of oil, and wave them before the Lord as a wave offering.

14.zh: 要宰了赎愆祭的羊羔，取些赎愆祭牲的血，抹在那求洁净人的右耳垂上和右手的大拇指上，并右脚的大拇指上。
14.en: He shall slaughter the lamb for the guilt offering and take some of its blood and put it on the lobe of the right ear of the one to be cleansed, on the thumb of his right hand and on the big toe of his right foot.

14.zh: 祭司要把些油倒在自己的左手掌里，
14.en: The priest is to pour some of the oil into the palm of his own left hand,

14.zh: 把左手里的油，在耶和华面前，用右手的一个指头弹七次，
14.en: and with his right forefinger sprinkle some of the oil from his palm seven times before the Lord .

14.zh: 又把手里的油抹些在那求洁净人的右耳垂上和右手的大拇指上，并右脚的大拇指上，就是抹赎愆祭之血的原处。
14.en: Some of the oil in his palm he is to put on the same places he put the blood of the guilt offering-on the lobe of the right ear of the one to be cleansed, on the thumb of his right hand and on the big toe of his right foot.

14.zh: 祭司手里所剩的油要抹在那求洁净人的头上，在耶和华面前为他赎罪。
14.en: The rest of the oil in his palm the priest shall put on the head of the one to be cleansed, to make atonement for him before the Lord .

14.zh: 那人又要照他的力量献上一只斑鸠或是一只雏鸽，
14.en: Then he shall sacrifice the doves or the young pigeons, which the person can afford,

14.zh: 就是他所能办的，一只为赎罪祭，一只为燔祭，与素祭一同献上；祭司要在耶和华面前为他赎罪。
14.en: one as a sin offering and the other as a burnt offering, together with the grain offering. In this way the priest will make atonement before the Lord on behalf of the one to be cleansed."

14.zh: 这是那有大痳疯灾病的人 、 不能将关乎得洁净之物预备够数的条例。
14.en: These are the regulations for anyone who has an infectious skin disease and who cannot afford the regular offerings for his cleansing.

14.zh: 耶和华晓谕摩西 、 亚伦说：
14.en: The Lord said to Moses and Aaron,

14.zh: 你们到了我赐给你们为业的迦南地，我若使你们所得为业之地的房屋中有大痳疯的灾病，
14.en: "When you enter the land of Canaan, which I am giving you as your possession, and I put a spreading mildew in a house in that land,

14.zh: 房主就要去告诉祭司说：据我看，房屋中似乎有灾病。
14.en: the owner of the house must go and tell the priest, 'I have seen something that looks like mildew in my house.'

14.zh: 祭司还没有进去察看灾病以前，就要吩咐人把房子腾空，免得房子里所有的都成了不洁净；然后祭司要进去察看房子。
14.en: The priest is to order the house to be emptied before he goes in to examine the mildew, so that nothing in the house will be pronounced unclean. After this the priest is to go in and inspect the house.

14.zh: 他要察看那灾病，灾病若在房子的墙上有发绿或发红的凹斑纹，现象洼于墙，
14.en: He is to examine the mildew on the walls, and if it has greenish or reddish depressions that appear to be deeper than the surface of the wall,

14.zh: 祭司就要出到房门外，把房子封锁七天。
14.en: the priest shall go out the doorway of the house and close it up for seven days.

14.zh: 第七天，祭司要再去察看，灾病若在房子的墙上发散，
14.en: On the seventh day the priest shall return to inspect the house. If the mildew has spread on the walls,

14.zh: 就要吩咐人把那有灾病的石头挖出来，扔在城外不洁净之处；
14.en: he is to order that the contaminated stones be torn out and thrown into an unclean place outside the town.

14.zh: 也要叫人刮房内的四围，所刮掉的灰泥要倒在城外不洁净之处；
14.en: He must have all the inside walls of the house scraped and the material that is scraped off dumped into an unclean place outside the town.

14.zh: 又要用别的石头代替那挖出来的石头，要另用灰泥墁房子。
14.en: Then they are to take other stones to replace these and take new clay and plaster the house.

14.zh: 他挖出石头，刮了房子，墁了以后，灾病若在房子里又发现，
14.en: "If the mildew reappears in the house after the stones have been torn out and the house scraped and plastered,

14.zh: 祭司就要进去察看，灾病若在房子里发散，这就是房内蚕食的大痳疯，是不洁净。
14.en: the priest is to go and examine it and, if the mildew has spread in the house, it is a destructive mildew; the house is unclean.

14.zh: 他就要拆毁房子，把石头 、 木头 、 灰泥都搬到城外不洁净之处。
14.en: It must be torn down-its stones, timbers and all the plaster-and taken out of the town to an unclean place.

14.zh: 在房子封锁的时候，进去的人必不洁净到晚上；
14.en: "Anyone who goes into the house while it is closed up will be unclean till evening.

14.zh: 在房子里躺著的必洗衣服；在房子里吃饭的也必洗衣服。
14.en: Anyone who sleeps or eats in the house must wash his clothes.

14.zh: 房子墁了以后，祭司若进去察看，见灾病在房内没有发散，就要定房子为洁净，因为灾病已经消除。
14.en: "But if the priest comes to examine it and the mildew has not spread after the house has been plastered, he shall pronounce the house clean, because the mildew is gone.

14.zh: 要为洁净房子取两只鸟和香柏木 、 朱红色线并牛膝草，
14.en: To purify the house he is to take two birds and some cedar wood, scarlet yarn and hyssop.

14.zh: 用瓦器盛活水，把一只鸟宰在上面，
14.en: He shall kill one of the birds over fresh water in a clay pot.

14.zh: 把香柏木 、 牛膝草 、 朱红色线，并那活鸟，都蘸在被宰的鸟血中与活水中，用以洒房子七次。
14.en: Then he is to take the cedar wood, the hyssop, the scarlet yarn and the live bird, dip them into the blood of the dead bird and the fresh water, and sprinkle the house seven times.

14.zh: 要用鸟血 、 活水 、 活鸟 、 香柏木 、 牛膝草，并朱红色线，洁净那房子。
14.en: He shall purify the house with the bird's blood, the fresh water, the live bird, the cedar wood, the hyssop and the scarlet yarn.

14.zh: 但要把活鸟放在城外田野里。这样洁净房子（原文是为房子赎罪），房子就洁净了。
14.en: Then he is to release the live bird in the open fields outside the town. In this way he will make atonement for the house, and it will be clean."

14.zh: 这是为各类大痳疯的灾病和头疥，
14.en: These are the regulations for any infectious skin disease, for an itch,

14.zh: 并衣服与房子的大痳疯，
14.en: for mildew in clothing or in a house,

14.zh: 以及疖子 、 癣 、 火斑所立的条例，
14.en: and for a swelling, a rash or a bright spot,

14.zh: 指明何时为洁净，何时为不洁净。这是大痳疯的条例。
14.en: to determine when something is clean or unclean. These are the regulations for infectious skin diseases and mildew.

15.zh: 耶和华对摩西 、 亚伦说：
15.en: The Lord said to Moses andAaron,

15.zh: 你们晓谕以色列人说：人若身患漏症，他因这漏症就不洁净了。
15.en: "Speak to the Israelites and say to them: 'When any man has a bodily discharge, the discharge is unclean.

15.zh: 他患漏症，无论是下流的，是止住的，都是不洁净。
15.en: Whether it continues flowing from his body or is blocked, it will make him unclean. This is how his discharge will bring about uncleanness:

15.zh: 他所躺的床都为不洁净，所坐的物也为不洁净。
15.en: " 'Any bed the man with a discharge lies on will be unclean, and anything he sits on will be unclean.

15.zh: 凡摸那床的，必不洁净到晚上，并要洗衣服，用水洗澡。
15.en: Anyone who touches his bed must wash his clothes and bathe with water, and he will be unclean till evening.

15.zh: 那坐患漏症人所坐之物的，必不洁净到晚上，并要洗衣服，用水洗澡。
15.en: Whoever sits on anything that the man with a discharge sat on must wash his clothes and bathe with water, and he will be unclean till evening.

15.zh: 那摸患漏症人身体的，必不洁净到晚上，并要洗衣服，用水洗澡。
15.en: " 'Whoever touches the man who has a discharge must wash his clothes and bathe with water, and he will be unclean till evening.

15.zh: 若患漏症人吐在洁净的人身上，那人必不洁净到晚上，并要洗衣服，用水洗澡。
15.en: " 'If the man with the discharge spits on someone who is clean, that person must wash his clothes and bathe with water, and he will be unclean till evening.

15.zh: 患漏症人所骑的鞍子也为不洁净。
15.en: " 'Everything the man sits on when riding will be unclean,

15.zh: 凡摸了他身下之物的，必不洁净到晚上；拿了那物的，必不洁净到晚上，并要洗衣服，用水洗澡。
15.en: and whoever touches any of the things that were under him will be unclean till evening; whoever picks up those things must wash his clothes and bathe with water, and he will be unclean till evening.

15.zh: 患漏症的人没有用水涮手，无论摸了谁，谁必不洁净到晚上，并要洗衣服，用水洗澡。
15.en: " 'Anyone the man with a discharge touches without rinsing his hands with water must wash his clothes and bathe with water, and he will be unclean till evening.

15.zh: 患漏症人所摸的瓦器就必打破；所摸的一切木器也必用水涮洗。
