15.en: " 'A clay pot that the man touches must be broken, and any wooden article is to be rinsed with water.

15.zh: 患漏症的人痊愈了，就要为洁净自己计算七天，也必洗衣服，用活水洗身，就洁净了。
15.en: " 'When a man is cleansed from his discharge, he is to count off seven days for his ceremonial cleansing; he must wash his clothes and bathe himself with fresh water, and he will be clean.

15.zh: 第八天，要取两只斑鸠或是两只雏鸽，来到会幕门口 、 耶和华面前，把鸟交给祭司。
15.en: On the eighth day he must take two doves or two young pigeons and come before the Lord to the entrance to the Tent of Meeting and give them to the priest.

15.zh: 祭司要献上一只为赎罪祭，一只为燔祭；因那人患的漏症，祭司要在耶和华面前为他赎罪。
15.en: The priest is to sacrifice them, the one for a sin offering and the other for a burnt offering. In this way he will make atonement before the Lord for the man because of his discharge.

15.zh: 人若梦遗，他必不洁净到晚上，并要用水洗全身。
15.en: " 'When a man has an emission of semen, he must bathe his whole body with water, and he will be unclean till evening.

15.zh: 无论是衣服是皮子，被精所染，必不洁净到晚上，并要用水洗。
15.en: Any clothing or leather that has semen on it must be washed with water, and it will be unclean till evening.

15.zh: 若男女交合，两个人必不洁净到晚上，并要用水洗澡。
15.en: When a man lies with a woman and there is an emission of semen, both must bathe with water, and they will be unclean till evening.

15.zh: 女人行经，必污秽七天；凡摸他的，必不洁净到晚上。
15.en: " 'When a woman has her regular flow of blood, the impurity of her monthly period will last seven days, and anyone who touches her will be unclean till evening.

15.zh: 女人在污秽之中，凡他所躺的物件都为不洁净，所坐的物件也都不洁净。
15.en: " 'Anything she lies on during her period will be unclean, and anything she sits on will be unclean.

15.zh: 凡摸他床的，必不洁净到晚上，并要洗衣服，用水洗澡。
15.en: Whoever touches her bed must wash his clothes and bathe with water, and he will be unclean till evening.

15.zh: 凡摸他所坐甚么物件的，必不洁净到晚上，并要洗衣服，用水洗澡。
15.en: Whoever touches anything she sits on must wash his clothes and bathe with water, and he will be unclean till evening.

15.zh: 在女人的床上，或在他坐的物上，若有别的物件，人一摸了，必不洁净到晚上。
15.en: Whether it is the bed or anything she was sitting on, when anyone touches it, he will be unclean till evening.

15.zh: 男人若与那女人同房，染了他的污秽，就要七天不洁净；所躺的床也为不洁净。
15.en: " 'If a man lies with her and her monthly flow touches him, he will be unclean for seven days; any bed he lies on will be unclean.

15.zh: 女人若在经期以外患多日的血漏，或是经期过长，有了漏症，他就因这漏症不洁净，与他在经期不洁净一样。
15.en: " 'When a woman has a discharge of blood for many days at a time other than her monthly period or has a discharge that continues beyond her period, she will be unclean as long as she has the discharge, just as in the days of her period.

15.zh: 他在患漏症的日子所躺的床 、 所坐的物都要看为不洁净，与他月经的时候一样。
15.en: Any bed she lies on while her discharge continues will be unclean, as is her bed during her monthly period, and anything she sits on will be unclean, as during her period.

15.zh: 凡摸这些物件的，就为不洁净，必不洁净到晚上，并要洗衣服，用水洗澡。
15.en: Whoever touches them will be unclean; he must wash his clothes and bathe with water, and he will be unclean till evening.

15.zh: 女人的漏症若好了，就要计算七天，然后才为洁净。
15.en: " 'When she is cleansed from her discharge, she must count off seven days, and after that she will be ceremonially clean.

15.zh: 第八天，要取两只斑鸠或是两只雏鸽，带到会幕门口给祭司。
15.en: On the eighth day she must take two doves or two young pigeons and bring them to the priest at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting.

15.zh: 祭司要献一只为赎罪祭，一只为燔祭；因那人血漏不洁，祭司要在耶和华面前为他赎罪。
15.en: The priest is to sacrifice one for a sin offering and the other for a burnt offering. In this way he will make atonement for her before the Lord for the uncleanness of her discharge.

15.zh: 你们要这样使以色列人与他们的污秽隔绝，免得他们玷污我的帐幕，就因自己的污秽死亡。
15.en: " 'You must keep the Israelites separate from things that make them unclean, so they will not die in their uncleanness for defiling my dwelling place, which is among them.' "

15.zh: 这是患漏症和梦遗而不洁净的，
15.en: These are the regulations for a man with a discharge, for anyone made unclean by an emission of semen,

15.zh: 并有月经病的和患漏症的，无论男女，并人与不洁净女人同房的条例。
15.en: for a woman in her monthly period, for a man or a woman with a discharge, and for a man who lies with a woman who is ceremonially unclean.

16.zh: 亚伦的两个儿子近到耶和华面前死了。死了之后，耶和华晓谕摩西说：
16.en: The Lord spoke to Moses after thedeath of the two sons of Aaron who died when they approached the Lord .

16.zh: 要告诉你哥哥亚伦，不可随时进圣所的幔子内 、 到柜上的施恩座前，免得他死亡，因为我要从云中显现在施恩座上。
16.en: The Lord said to Moses: "Tell your brother Aaron not to come whenever he chooses into the Most Holy Place behind the curtain in front of the atonement cover on the ark, or else he will die, because I appear in the cloud over the atonement cover.

16.zh: 亚伦进圣所，要带一只公牛犊为赎罪祭，一只公绵羊为燔祭。
16.en: "This is how Aaron is to enter the sanctuary area: with a young bull for a sin offering and a ram for a burnt offering.

16.zh: 要穿上细麻布圣内袍，把细麻布裤子穿在身上，腰束细麻布带子，头戴细麻布冠冕；这都是圣服。他要用水洗身，然后穿戴。
16.en: He is to put on the sacred linen tunic, with linen undergarments next to his body; he is to tie the linen sash around him and put on the linen turban. These are sacred garments; so he must bathe himself with water before he puts them on.

16.zh: 要从以色列会众取两只公山羊为赎罪祭，一只公绵羊为燔祭。
16.en: From the Israelite community he is to take two male goats for a sin offering and a ram for a burnt offering.

16.zh: 亚伦要把赎罪祭的公牛奉上，为自己和本家赎罪；
16.en: "Aaron is to offer the bull for his own sin offering to make atonement for himself and his household.

16.zh: 也要把两只公山羊安置在会幕门口 、 耶和华面前，
16.en: Then he is to take the two goats and present them before the Lord at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting.

16.zh: 为那两只羊拈阄，一阄归与耶和华，一阄归与阿撒泻勒。
16.en: He is to cast lots for the two goats-one lot for the Lord and the other for the scapegoat.

16.zh: 亚伦要把那拈阄归与耶和华的羊献为赎罪祭，
16.en: Aaron shall bring the goat whose lot falls to the Lord and sacrifice it for a sin offering.

16.zh: 但那拈阄归与阿撒泻勒的羊要活著安置在耶和华面前，用以赎罪，打发人送到旷野去，归与阿撒泻勒。
16.en: But the goat chosen by lot as the scapegoat shall be presented alive before the Lord to be used for making atonement by sending it into the desert as a scapegoat.

16.zh: 亚伦要把赎罪祭的公牛带来宰了，为自己和本家赎罪；
16.en: "Aaron shall bring the bull for his own sin offering to make atonement for himself and his household, and he is to slaughter the bull for his own sin offering.

16.zh: 拿香炉，从耶和华面前的坛上盛满火炭，又拿一捧捣细的香料，都带入幔子内，
16.en: He is to take a censer full of burning coals from the altar before the Lord and two handfuls of finely ground fragrant incense and take them behind the curtain.

16.zh: 在耶和华面前，把香放在火上，使香的烟云遮掩法柜上的施恩座，免得他死亡；
16.en: He is to put the incense on the fire before the Lord , and the smoke of the incense will conceal the atonement cover above the Testimony, so that he will not die.

16.zh: 也要取些公牛的血，用指头弹在施恩座的东面，又在施恩座的前面弹血七次。
16.en: He is to take some of the bull's blood and with his finger sprinkle it on the front of the atonement cover; then he shall sprinkle some of it with his finger seven times before the atonement cover.

16.zh: 随后他要宰那为百姓作赎罪祭的公山羊，把羊的血带入幔子内，弹在施恩座的上面和前面，好像弹公牛的血一样。
16.en: "He shall then slaughter the goat for the sin offering for the people and take its blood behind the curtain and do with it as he did with the bull's blood: He shall sprinkle it on the atonement cover and in front of it.

16.zh: 他因以色列人诸般的污秽 、 过犯，就是他们一切的罪愆，当这样在圣所行赎罪之礼，并因会幕在他们污秽之中，也要照样而行。
16.en: In this way he will make atonement for the Most Holy Place because of the uncleanness and rebellion of the Israelites, whatever their sins have been. He is to do the same for the Tent of Meeting, which is among them in the midst of their uncleanness.

16.zh: 他进圣所赎罪的时候，会幕里不可有人，直等到他为自己和本家并以色列全会众赎了罪出来。
16.en: No one is to be in the Tent of Meeting from the time Aaron goes in to make atonement in the Most Holy Place until he comes out, having made atonement for himself, his household and the whole community of Israel.

16.zh: 他出来，要到耶和华面前的坛那里，在坛上行赎罪之礼，又要取些公牛的血和公山羊的血，抹在坛上四角的周围；
16.en: "Then he shall come out to the altar that is before the Lord and make atonement for it. He shall take some of the bull's blood and some of the goat's blood and put it on all the horns of the altar.

16.zh: 也要用指头把血弹在坛上七次，洁净了坛，从坛上除掉以色列人诸般的污秽，使坛成圣。
16.en: He shall sprinkle some of the blood on it with his finger seven times to cleanse it and to consecrate it from the uncleanness of the Israelites.

16.zh: 亚伦为圣所和会幕并坛献完了赎罪祭，就要把那只活著的公山羊奉上。
16.en: "When Aaron has finished making atonement for the Most Holy Place, the Tent of Meeting and the altar, he shall bring forward the live goat.

16.zh: 两手按在羊头上，承认以色列人诸般的罪孽过犯，就是他们一切的罪愆，把这罪都归在羊的头上，藉著所派之人的手，送到旷野去。
16.en: He is to lay both hands on the head of the live goat and confess over it all the wickedness and rebellion of the Israelites-all their sins-and put them on the goat's head. He shall send the goat away into the desert in the care of a man appointed for the task.

16.zh: 要把这羊放在旷野，这羊要担当他们一切的罪孽，带到无人之地。
16.en: The goat will carry on itself all their sins to a solitary place; and the man shall release it in the desert.

16.zh: 亚伦要进会幕，把他进圣所时所穿的细麻布衣服脱下，放在那里，
16.en: "Then Aaron is to go into the Tent of Meeting and take off the linen garments he put on before he entered the Most Holy Place, and he is to leave them there.

16.zh: 又要在圣处用水洗身，穿上衣服，出来，把自己的燔祭和百姓的燔祭献上，为自己和百姓赎罪。
16.en: He shall bathe himself with water in a holy place and put on his regular garments. Then he shall come out and sacrifice the burnt offering for himself and the burnt offering for the people, to make atonement for himself and for the people.

16.zh: 赎罪祭牲的脂油要在坛上焚烧。
16.en: He shall also burn the fat of the sin offering on the altar.

16.zh: 那放羊归与阿撒泻勒的人要洗衣服，用水洗身，然后进营。
16.en: "The man who releases the goat as a scapegoat must wash his clothes and bathe himself with water; afterward he may come into the camp.

16.zh: 作赎罪祭的公牛和公山羊的血既带入圣所赎罪，这牛羊就要搬到营外，将皮 、 肉 、 粪用火焚烧。
16.en: The bull and the goat for the sin offerings, whose blood was brought into the Most Holy Place to make atonement, must be taken outside the camp; their hides, flesh and offal are to be burned up.

16.zh: 焚烧的人要洗衣服，用水洗身，然后进营。
16.en: The man who burns them must wash his clothes and bathe himself with water; afterward he may come into the camp.

16.zh: 每逢七月初十日，你们要刻苦己心，无论是本地人，是寄居在你们中间的外人，甚么工都不可做；这要作你们永远的定例。
16.en: "This is to be a lasting ordinance for you: On the tenth day of the seventh month you must deny yourselves and not do any work-whether native-born or an alien living among you-

16.zh: 因在这日要为你们赎罪，使你们洁净。你们要在耶和华面前得以洁净，脱尽一切的罪愆。
16.en: because on this day atonement will be made for you, to cleanse you. Then, before the Lord , you will be clean from all your sins.

16.zh: 这日你们要守为圣安息日，要刻苦己心；这为永远的定例。
16.en: It is a sabbath of rest, and you must deny yourselves; it is a lasting ordinance.

16.zh: 那受膏 、 接续他父亲承接圣职的祭司要穿上细麻布的圣衣，行赎罪之礼。
16.en: The priest who is anointed and ordained to succeed his father as high priest is to make atonement. He is to put on the sacred linen garments

16.zh: 他要在至圣所和会幕与坛行赎罪之礼，并要为众祭司和会众的百姓赎罪。
16.en: and make atonement for the Most Holy Place, for the Tent of Meeting and the altar, and for the priests and all the people of the community.

16.zh: 这要作你们永远的定例 ─ 就是因以色列人一切的罪，要一年一次为他们赎罪。于是，亚伦照耶和华所吩咐摩西的行了。
16.en: "This is to be a lasting ordinance for you: Atonement is to be made once a year for all the sins of the Israelites." And it was done, as the Lord commanded Moses.

17.zh: 你晓谕亚伦和他儿子并以色列众人说，耶和华所吩咐的乃是这样：
17.en: "Speak to Aaron and his sons and to all the Israelites and say to them: 'This is what the Lord has commanded:

17.zh: 凡以色列家中的人宰公牛，或是绵羊羔，或是山羊，不拘宰于营内营外，
17.en: Any Israelite who sacrifices an ox, a lamb or a goat in the camp or outside of it

17.zh: 若未曾牵到会幕门口 、 耶和华的帐幕前献给耶和华为供物，流血的罪必归到那人身上。他流了血，要从民中剪除。
17.en: instead of bringing it to the entrance to the Tent of Meeting to present it as an offering to the Lord in front of the tabernacle of the Lord -that man shall be considered guilty of bloodshed; he has shed blood and must be cut off from his people.

17.zh: 这是为要使以色列人把他们在田野里所献的祭带到会幕门口 、 耶和华面前，交给祭司，献与耶和华为平安祭。
17.en: This is so the Israelites will bring to the Lord the sacrifices they are now making in the open fields. They must bring them to the priest, that is, to the Lord , at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting and sacrifice them as fellowship offerings.

17.zh: 祭司要把血洒在会幕门口 、 耶和华的坛上，把脂油焚烧，献给耶和华为馨香的祭。
17.en: The priest is to sprinkle the blood against the altar of the Lord at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting and burn the fat as an aroma pleasing to the Lord .

17.zh: 他们不可再献祭给他们行邪淫所随从的鬼魔（原文作公山羊）；这要作他们世世代代永远的定例。
17.en: They must no longer offer any of their sacrifices to the goat idols to whom they prostitute themselves. This is to be a lasting ordinance for them and for the generations to come.'

17.zh: 你要晓谕他们说：凡以色列家中的人，或是寄居在他们中间的外人，献燔祭或是平安祭，
17.en: "Say to them: 'Any Israelite or any alien living among them who offers a burnt offering or sacrifice

17.zh: 若不带到会幕门口献给耶和华，那人必从民中剪除。
17.en: and does not bring it to the entrance to the Tent of Meeting to sacrifice it to the Lord -that man must be cut off from his people.

17.zh: 凡以色列家中的人，或是寄居在他们中间的外人，若吃甚么血，我必向那吃血的人变脸，把他从民中剪除。
17.en: " 'Any Israelite or any alien living among them who eats any blood-I will set my face against that person who eats blood and will cut him off from his people.

17.zh: 因为活物的生命是在血中。我把这血赐给你们，可以在坛上为你们的生命赎罪；因血里有生命，所以能赎罪。
17.en: For the life of a creature is in the blood, and I have given it to you to make atonement for yourselves on the altar; it is the blood that makes atonement for one's life.

17.zh: 因此，我对以色列人说：你们都不可吃血；寄居在你们中间的外人也不可吃血。
17.en: Therefore I say to the Israelites, "None of you may eat blood, nor may an alien living among you eat blood."

17.zh: 凡以色列人，或是寄居在他们中间的外人，若打猎得了可吃的禽兽，必放出他的血来，用土掩盖。
17.en: " 'Any Israelite or any alien living among you who hunts any animal or bird that may be eaten must drain out the blood and cover it with earth,

17.zh: 论到一切活物的生命，就在血中。所以我对以色列人说：无论甚么活物的血，你们都不可吃，因为一切活物的血就是他的生命。凡吃了血的，必被剪除。
17.en: because the life of every creature is its blood. That is why I have said to the Israelites, "You must not eat the blood of any creature, because the life of every creature is its blood; anyone who eats it must be cut off."

17.zh: 凡吃自死的，或是被野兽撕裂的，无论是本地人，是寄居的，必不洁净到晚上，都要洗衣服，用水洗身，到了晚上才为洁净。
17.en: " 'Anyone, whether native-born or alien, who eats anything found dead or torn by wild animals must wash his clothes and bathe with water, and he will be ceremonially unclean till evening; then he will be clean.

17.zh: 但他若不洗衣服，也不洗身，就必担当他的罪孽。
17.en: But if he does not wash his clothes and bathe himself, he will be held responsible.' "

18.zh: 耶和华对摩西说：
18.en: The Lord said to Moses,

18.zh: 你晓谕以色列人说：我是耶和华 ─ 你们的神。
18.en: "Speak to the Israelites and say to them: 'I am the Lord your God.

18.zh: 你们从前住的埃及地，那里人的行为，你们不可效法，我要领你们到的迦南地，那里人的行为也不可效法，也不可照他们的恶俗行。
18.en: You must not do as they do in Egypt, where you used to live, and you must not do as they do in the land of Canaan, where I am bringing you. Do not follow their practices.

18.zh: 你们要遵我的典章，守我的律例，按此而行。我是耶和华 ─ 你们的神。
18.en: You must obey my laws and be careful to follow my decrees. I am the Lord your God.

18.zh: 所以，你们要守我的律例典章；人若遵行，就必因此活著。我是耶和华。
18.en: Keep my decrees and laws, for the man who obeys them will live by them. I am the Lord .

18.zh: 你们都不可露骨肉之亲的下体，亲近他们。我是耶和华。
18.en: " 'No one is to approach any close relative to have sexual relations. I am the Lord .

18.zh: 不可露你母亲的下体，羞辱了你父亲。他是你的母亲，不可露他的下体。
18.en: " 'Do not dishonor your father by having sexual relations with your mother. She is your mother; do not have relations with her.

18.zh: 不可露你继母的下体；这本是你父亲的下体。
18.en: " 'Do not have sexual relations with your father's wife; that would dishonor your father.

18.zh: 你的姊妹，不拘是异母同父的，是异父同母的，无论是生在家生在外的，都不可露他们的下体。
18.en: " 'Do not have sexual relations with your sister, either your father's daughter or your mother's daughter, whether she was born in the same home or elsewhere.

18.zh: 不可露你孙女或是外孙女的下体，露了他们的下体就是露了自己的下体。
18.en: " 'Do not have sexual relations with your son's daughter or your daughter's daughter; that would dishonor you.

18.zh: 你继母从你父亲生的女儿本是你的妹妹，不可露他的下体。
18.en: " 'Do not have sexual relations with the daughter of your father's wife, born to your father; she is your sister.

18.zh: 不可露你姑母的下体；他是你父亲的骨肉之亲。
18.en: " 'Do not have sexual relations with your father's sister; she is your father's close relative.

18.zh: 不可露你姨母的下体；他是你母亲的骨肉之亲。
18.en: " 'Do not have sexual relations with your mother's sister, because she is your mother's close relative.

18.zh: 不可亲近你伯叔之妻，羞辱了你伯叔；他是你的伯叔母。
18.en: " 'Do not dishonor your father's brother by approaching his wife to have sexual relations; she is your aunt.

18.zh: 不可露你儿妇的下体；他是你儿子的妻，不可露他的下体。
18.en: " 'Do not have sexual relations with your daughter-in- law. She is your son's wife; do not have relations with her.

18.zh: 不可露你弟兄妻子的下体；这本是你弟兄的下体。
18.en: " 'Do not have sexual relations with your brother's wife; that would dishonor your brother.

18.zh: 不可露了妇人的下体，又露他女儿的下体，也不可娶他孙女或是外孙女，露他们的下体；他们是骨肉之亲，这本是大恶。
18.en: " 'Do not have sexual relations with both a woman and her daughter. Do not have sexual relations with either her son's daughter or her daughter's daughter; they are her close relatives. That is wickedness.

18.zh: 你妻还在的时候，不可另娶他的姊妹作对头，露他的下体。
18.en: " 'Do not take your wife's sister as a rival wife and have sexual relations with her while your wife is living.

18.zh: 女人行经不洁净的时候，不可露他的下体，与他亲近。
18.en: " 'Do not approach a woman to have sexual relations during the uncleanness of her monthly period.

18.zh: 不可与邻舍的妻行淫，玷污自己。
18.en: " 'Do not have sexual relations with your neighbor's wife and defile yourself with her.

18.zh: 不可使你的儿女经火归与摩洛，也不可亵渎你神的名。我是耶和华。
18.en: " 'Do not give any of your children to be sacrificed to Molech, for you must not profane the name of your God. I am the Lord .

18.zh: 不可与男人苟合，像与女人一样；这本是可憎恶的。
18.en: " 'Do not lie with a man as one lies with a woman; that is detestable.

18.zh: 不可与兽淫合，玷污自己。女人也不可站在兽前，与他淫合；这本是逆性的事。
18.en: " 'Do not have sexual relations with an animal and defile yourself with it. A woman must not present herself to an animal to have sexual relations with it; that is a perversion.

18.zh: 在这一切的事上，你们都不可玷污自己；因为我在你们面前所逐出的列邦，在这一切的事上玷污了自己；
18.en: " 'Do not defile yourselves in any of these ways, because this is how the nations that I am going to drive out before you became defiled.

18.zh: 连地也玷污了，所以我追讨那地的罪孽，那地也吐出他的居民。
18.en: Even the land was defiled; so I punished it for its sin, and the land vomited out its inhabitants.

18.zh: 故此，你们要守我的律例典章。这一切可憎恶的事，无论是本地人，是寄居在你们中间的外人，都不可行，
18.en: But you must keep my decrees and my laws. The native-born and the aliens living among you must not do any of these detestable things,

18.zh: 在你们以先居住那地的人行了这一切可憎恶的事，地就玷污了，
18.en: for all these things were done by the people who lived in the land before you, and the land became defiled.

18.zh: 免得你们玷污那地的时候，地就把你们吐出，像吐出在你们以先的国民一样。
18.en: And if you defile the land, it will vomit you out as it vomited out the nations that were before you.

18.zh: 无论甚么人，行了其中可憎的一件事，必从民中剪除。
18.en: " 'Everyone who does any of these detestable things-such persons must be cut off from their people.

18.zh: 所以，你们要守我所吩咐的，免得你们随从那些可憎的恶俗，就是在你们以先的人所常行的，以致玷污了自己。我是耶和华 ─ 你们的神。
18.en: Keep my requirements and do not follow any of the detestable customs that were practiced before you came and do not defile yourselves with them. I am the Lord your God.' "

19.zh: 耶和华对摩西说：
19.en: The Lord said to Moses,

19.zh: 你晓谕以色列全会众说：你们要圣洁，因为我耶和华 ─ 你们的神是圣洁的。
19.en: "Speak to the entire assembly of Israel and say to them: 'Be holy because I, the Lord your God, am holy.

19.zh: 你们各人都当孝敬父母，也要守我的安息日。我是耶和华 ─ 你们的神。
19.en: " 'Each of you must respect his mother and father, and you must observe my Sabbaths. I am the Lord your God.

19.zh: 你们不可偏向虚无的神，也不可为自己铸造神像。我是耶和华 ─ 你们的神。
19.en: " 'Do not turn to idols or make gods of cast metal for yourselves. I am the Lord your God.

19.zh: 你们献平安祭给耶和华的时候，要献得可蒙悦纳。
19.en: " 'When you sacrifice a fellowship offering to the Lord , sacrifice it in such a way that it will be accepted on your behalf.

19.zh: 这祭物要在献的那一天和第二天吃，若有剩到第三天的，就必用火焚烧。
19.en: It shall be eaten on the day you sacrifice it or on the next day; anything left over until the third day must be burned up.

19.zh: 第三天若再吃，这就为可憎恶的，必不蒙悦纳。
19.en: If any of it is eaten on the third day, it is impure and will not be accepted.

19.zh: 凡吃的人必担当他的罪孽；因为他亵渎了耶和华的圣物，那人必从民中剪除。
19.en: Whoever eats it will be held responsible because he has desecrated what is holy to the Lord ; that person must be cut off from his people.

19.zh: 在你们的地收割庄稼，不可割尽田角，也不可拾取所遗落的。
19.en: " 'When you reap the harvest of your land, do not reap to the very edges of your field or gather the gleanings of your harvest.

19.zh: 不可摘尽葡萄园的果子，也不可拾取葡萄园所掉的果子；要留给穷人和寄居的。我是耶和华你 ─ 们的神。
19.en: Do not go over your vineyard a second time or pick up the grapes that have fallen. Leave them for the poor and the alien. I am the Lord your God.

19.zh: 你们不可偷盗，不可欺骗，也不可彼此说谎。
19.en: " 'Do not steal. " 'Do not lie. " 'Do not deceive one another.

19.zh: 不可指著我的名起假誓，亵渎你神的名。我是耶和华。
19.en: " 'Do not swear falsely by my name and so profane the name of your God. I am the Lord .

19.zh: 不可欺压你的邻舍，也不可抢夺他的物。雇工人的工价，不可在你那里过夜，留到早晨。
19.en: " 'Do not defraud your neighbor or rob him. " 'Do not hold back the wages of a hired man overnight.

19.zh: 不可咒骂聋子，也不可将绊脚石放在瞎子面前，只要敬畏你的神。我是耶和华。
19.en: " 'Do not curse the deaf or put a stumbling block in front of the blind, but fear your God. I am the Lord .

19.zh: 你们施行审判，不可行不义；不可偏护穷人，也不可重看有势力的人，只要按著公义审判你的邻舍。
19.en: " 'Do not pervert justice; do not show partiality to the poor or favoritism to the great, but judge your neighbor fairly.

19.zh: 不可在民中往来搬弄是非，也不可与邻舍为敌，置之于死（原文作流他的血）。我是耶和华。
19.en: " 'Do not go about spreading slander among your people. " 'Do not do anything that endangers your neighbor's life. I am the Lord .

19.zh: 不可心里恨你的弟兄；总要指摘你的邻舍，免得因他担罪。
19.en: " 'Do not hate your brother in your heart. Rebuke your neighbor frankly so you will not share in his guilt.

19.zh: 不可报仇，也不可埋怨你本国的子民，却要爱人如己。我是耶和华。
19.en: " 'Do not seek revenge or bear a grudge against one of your people, but love your neighbor as yourself. I am the Lord .

19.zh: 你们要守我的律例。不可叫你的牲畜与异类配合；不可用两样搀杂的种种你的地，也不可用两样搀杂的料做衣服穿在身上。
19.en: " 'Keep my decrees. " 'Do not mate different kinds of animals. " 'Do not plant your field with two kinds of seed. " 'Do not wear clothing woven of two kinds of material.

19.zh: 婢女许配了丈夫，还没有被赎 、 得释放，人若与他行淫，二人要受刑罚，却不把他们治死，因为婢女还没有得自由。
19.en: " 'If a man sleeps with a woman who is a slave girl promised to another man but who has not been ransomed or given her freedom, there must be due punishment. Yet they are not to be put to death, because she had not been freed.

19.zh: 那人要把赎愆祭，就是一只公绵羊牵到会幕门口 、 耶和华面前。
19.en: The man, however, must bring a ram to the entrance to the Tent of Meeting for a guilt offering to the Lord .

19.zh: 祭司要用赎愆祭的羊在耶和华面前赎他所犯的罪，他的罪就必蒙赦免。
19.en: With the ram of the guilt offering the priest is to make atonement for him before the Lord for the sin he has committed, and his sin will be forgiven.

19.zh: 你们到了迦南地，栽种各样结果子的树木，就要以所结的果子如未受割礼的一样。三年之久，你们要以这些果子，如未受割礼的，是不可吃的。
19.en: " 'When you enter the land and plant any kind of fruit tree, regard its fruit as forbidden. For three years you are to consider it forbidden ; it must not be eaten.

19.zh: 但第四年所结的果子全要成为圣，用以赞美耶和华。
19.en: In the fourth year all its fruit will be holy, an offering of praise to the Lord .

19.zh: 第五年，你们要吃那树上的果子，好叫树给你们结果子更多。我是耶和华 ─ 你们的神。
19.en: But in the fifth year you may eat its fruit. In this way your harvest will be increased. I am the Lord your God.

19.zh: 你们不可吃带血的物；不可用法术，也不可观兆。
19.en: " 'Do not eat any meat with the blood still in it. " 'Do not practice divination or sorcery.

19.zh: 头的周围不可剃，（周围或作：两鬓）胡须的周围也不可损坏。
19.en: " 'Do not cut the hair at the sides of your head or clip off the edges of your beard.

19.zh: 不可为死人用刀划身，也不可在身上刺花纹。我是耶和华。
19.en: " 'Do not cut your bodies for the dead or put tattoo marks on yourselves. I am the Lord .

19.zh: 不可辱没你的女儿，使他为娼妓，恐怕地上的人专向淫乱，地就满了大恶。
19.en: " 'Do not degrade your daughter by making her a prostitute, or the land will turn to prostitution and be filled with wickedness.

19.zh: 你们要守我的安息日，敬我的圣所。我是耶和华。
19.en: " 'Observe my Sabbaths and have reverence for my sanctuary. I am the Lord .

19.zh: 不可偏向那些交鬼的和行巫术的；不可求问他们，以致被他们玷污了。我是耶和华 ─ 你们的神。
19.en: " 'Do not turn to mediums or seek out spiritists, for you will be defiled by them. I am the Lord your God.

19.zh: 在白发的人面前，你要站起来；也要尊敬老人，又要敬畏你的神。我是耶和华。
19.en: " 'Rise in the presence of the aged, show respect for the elderly and revere your God. I am the Lord .

19.zh: 若有外人在你们国中和你同居，就不可欺负他。
19.en: " 'When an alien lives with you in your land, do not mistreat him.

19.zh: 和你们同居的外人，你们要看他如本地人一样，并要爱他如己，因为你们在埃及地也作过寄居的。我是耶和华 ─ 你们的神。
19.en: The alien living with you must be treated as one of your native-born. Love him as yourself, for you were aliens in Egypt. I am the Lord your God.

19.zh: 你们施行审判，不可行不义；在尺 、 秤 、 升 、 斗上也是如此。
19.en: " 'Do not use dishonest standards when measuring length, weight or quantity.

19.zh: 要用公道天平 、 公道法码 、 公道升斗 、 公道秤。我是耶和华 ─ 你们的神，曾把你们从埃及地领出来的。
19.en: Use honest scales and honest weights, an honest ephah and an honest hin. I am the Lord your God, who brought you out of Egypt.

19.zh: 你们要谨守遵行我一切的律例典章。我是耶和华。
19.en: " 'Keep all my decrees and all my laws and follow them. I am the Lord .' "

20.zh: 耶和华对摩西说：
20.en: The Lord said to Moses,

20.zh: 你还要晓谕以色列人说：凡以色列人，或是在以色列中寄居的外人，把自己的儿女献给摩洛的，总要治死他；本地人要用石头把他打死。
20.en: "Say to the Israelites: 'Any Israelite or any alien living in Israel who gives any of his children to Molech must be put to death. The people of the community are to stone him.

20.zh: 我也要向那人变脸，把他从民中剪除；因为他把儿女献给摩洛，玷污我的圣所，亵渎我的圣名。
20.en: I will set my face against that man and I will cut him off from his people; for by giving his children to Molech, he has defiled my sanctuary and profaned my holy name.

20.zh: 那人把儿女献给摩洛，本地人若佯为不见，不把他治死，
20.en: If the people of the community close their eyes when that man gives one of his children to Molech and they fail to put him to death,

20.zh: 我就要向这人和他的家变脸，把他和一切随他与摩洛行邪淫的人都从民中剪除。
20.en: I will set my face against that man and his family and will cut off from their people both him and all who follow him in prostituting themselves to Molech.

20.zh: 人偏向交鬼的和行巫术的，随他们行邪淫，我要向那人变脸，把他从民中剪除。
20.en: " 'I will set my face against the person who turns to mediums and spiritists to prostitute himself by following them, and I will cut him off from his people.

20.zh: 所以你们要自洁成圣，因为我是耶和华 ─ 你们的神。
20.en: " 'Consecrate yourselves and be holy, because I am the Lord your God.

20.zh: 你们要谨守遵行我的律例；我是叫你们成圣的耶和华。
20.en: Keep my decrees and follow them. I am the Lord , who makes you holy.

20.zh: 凡咒骂父母的，总要治死他；他咒骂了父母，他的罪要归到他身上。（罪原文作血；本章同）
20.en: " 'If anyone curses his father or mother, he must be put to death. He has cursed his father or his mother, and his blood will be on his own head.

20.zh: 与邻舍之妻行淫的，奸夫淫妇都必治死。
20.en: " 'If a man commits adultery with another man's wife-with the wife of his neighbor-both the adulterer and the adulteress must be put to death.

20.zh: 与继母行淫的，就是羞辱了他父亲，总要把他们二人治死，罪要归到他们身上。
20.en: " 'If a man sleeps with his father's wife, he has dishonored his father. Both the man and the woman must be put to death; their blood will be on their own heads.

20.zh: 与儿妇同房的，总要把他们二人治死；他们行了逆伦的事，罪要归到他们身上。
20.en: " 'If a man sleeps with his daughter-in-law, both of them must be put to death. What they have done is a perversion; their blood will be on their own heads.

20.zh: 人若与男人苟合，像与女人一样，他们二人行了可憎的事，总要把他们治死，罪要归到他们身上。
20.en: " 'If a man lies with a man as one lies with a woman, both of them have done what is detestable. They must be put to death; their blood will be on their own heads.

20.zh: 人若娶妻，并娶其母，便是大恶，要把这三人用火焚烧，使你们中间免去大恶。
20.en: " 'If a man marries both a woman and her mother, it is wicked. Both he and they must be burned in the fire, so that no wickedness will be among you.

20.zh: 人若与兽淫合，总要治死他，也要杀那兽。
20.en: " 'If a man has sexual relations with an animal, he must be put to death, and you must kill the animal.

20.zh: 女人若与兽亲近，与他淫合，你要杀那女人和那兽，总要把他们治死，罪要归到他们身上。
20.en: " 'If a woman approaches an animal to have sexual relations with it, kill both the woman and the animal. They must be put to death; their blood will be on their own heads.

20.zh: 人若娶他的姊妹，无论是异母同父的，是异父同母的，彼此见了下体，这是可耻的事；他们必在本民的眼前被剪除。他露了姊妹的下体，必担当自己的罪孽。
20.en: " 'If a man marries his sister, the daughter of either his father or his mother, and they have sexual relations, it is a disgrace. They must be cut off before the eyes of their people. He has dishonored his sister and will be held responsible.

20.zh: 妇人有月经，若与他同房，露了他的下体，就是露了妇人的血源，妇人也露了自己的血源，二人必从民中剪除。
20.en: " 'If a man lies with a woman during her monthly period and has sexual relations with her, he has exposed the source of her flow, and she has also uncovered it. Both of them must be cut off from their people.

20.zh: 不可露姨母或是姑母的下体，这是露了骨肉之亲的下体；二人必担当自己的罪孽。
20.en: " 'Do not have sexual relations with the sister of either your mother or your father, for that would dishonor a close relative; both of you would be held responsible.

20.zh: 人若与伯叔之妻同房，就羞辱了他的伯叔；二人要担当自己的罪，必无子女而死。
20.en: " 'If a man sleeps with his aunt, he has dishonored his uncle. They will be held responsible; they will die childless.

20.zh: 人若娶弟兄之妻，这本是污秽的事，羞辱了他的弟兄；二人必无子女。
20.en: " 'If a man marries his brother's wife, it is an act of impurity; he has dishonored his brother. They will be childless.

20.zh: 所以，你们要谨守遵行我一切的律例典章，免得我领你们去住的那地把你们吐出。
20.en: " 'Keep all my decrees and laws and follow them, so that the land where I am bringing you to live may not vomit you out.

20.zh: 我在你们面前所逐出的国民，你们不可随从他们的风俗；因为他们行了这一切的事，所以我厌恶他们。
20.en: You must not live according to the customs of the nations I am going to drive out before you. Because they did all these things, I abhorred them.

20.zh: 但我对你们说过，你们要承受他们的地，就是我要赐给你们为业 、 流奶与蜜之地。我是耶和华 ─ 你们的神，使你们与万民有分别的。
20.en: But I said to you, "You will possess their land; I will give it to you as an inheritance, a land flowing with milk and honey." I am the Lord your God, who has set you apart from the nations.

20.zh: 所以，你们要把洁净和不洁净的禽兽分别出来；不可因我给你们分为不洁净的禽兽，或是滋生在地上的活物，使自己成为可憎恶的。
20.en: " 'You must therefore make a distinction between clean and unclean animals and between unclean and clean birds. Do not defile yourselves by any animal or bird or anything that moves along the ground-those which I have set apart as unclean for you.

20.zh: 你们要归我为圣，因为我 ─ 耶和华是圣的，并叫你们与万民有分别，使你们作我的民。
20.en: You are to be holy to me because I, the Lord , am holy, and I have set you apart from the nations to be my own.

20.zh: 无论男女，是交鬼的或行巫术的，总要治死他们。人必用石头把他们打死，罪要归到他们身上。
20.en: " 'A man or woman who is a medium or spiritist among you must be put to death. You are to stone them; their blood will be on their own heads.' "

21.zh: 耶和华对摩西说：你告诉亚伦子孙作祭司的说：祭司不可为民中的死人沾染自己，
21.en: The Lord said to Moses, "Speak to the priests, the sons of Aaron, and say to them: 'A priest must not make himself ceremonially unclean for any of his people who die,

21.zh: 除非为他骨肉之亲的父母 、 儿女 、 弟兄，
21.en: except for a close relative, such as his mother or father, his son or daughter, his brother,

21.zh: 和未曾出嫁 、 作处女的姊妹，才可以沾染自己。
21.en: or an unmarried sister who is dependent on him since she has no husband-for her he may make himself unclean.

21.zh: 祭司既在民中为首，就不可从俗沾染自己。
21.en: He must not make himself unclean for people related to him by marriage, and so defile himself.

21.zh: 不可使头光秃；不可剃除胡须的周围，也不可用刀划身。
21.en: " 'Priests must not shave their heads or shave off the edges of their beards or cut their bodies.

21.zh: 要归神为圣，不可亵渎神的名；因为耶和华的火祭，就是神的食物，是他们献的，所以他们要成为圣。
21.en: They must be holy to their God and must not profane the name of their God. Because they present the offerings made to the Lord by fire, the food of their God, they are to be holy.

21.zh: 不可娶妓女或被污的女人为妻，也不可娶被休的妇人为妻，因为祭司是归神为圣。
21.en: " 'They must not marry women defiled by prostitution or divorced from their husbands, because priests are holy to their God.

21.zh: 所以你要使他成圣，因为他奉献你神的食物；你要以他为圣，因为我 ─ 使你们成圣的耶和华 ─ 是圣的。
21.en: Regard them as holy, because they offer up the food of your God. Consider them holy, because I the Lord am holy-I who make you holy.

21.zh: 祭司的女儿若行淫辱没自己，就辱没了父亲，必用火将他焚烧。
21.en: " 'If a priest's daughter defiles herself by becoming a prostitute, she disgraces her father; she must be burned in the fire.

21.zh: 在弟兄中作大祭司 、 头上倒了膏油 、 又承接圣职，穿了圣衣的，不可蓬头散发，也不可撕裂衣服。
21.en: " 'The high priest, the one among his brothers who has had the anointing oil poured on his head and who has been ordained to wear the priestly garments, must not let his hair become unkempt or tear his clothes.

21.zh: 不可挨近死尸，也不可为父母沾染自己。
21.en: He must not enter a place where there is a dead body. He must not make himself unclean, even for his father or mother,

21.zh: 不可出圣所，也不可亵渎神的圣所，因为神膏油的冠冕在他头上。我是耶和华。
21.en: nor leave the sanctuary of his God or desecrate it, because he has been dedicated by the anointing oil of his God. I am the Lord .

21.zh: 他要娶处女为妻。
21.en: " 'The woman he marries must be a virgin.

21.zh: 寡妇或是被休的妇人，或是被污为妓的女人，都不可娶；只可娶本民中的处女为妻。
21.en: He must not marry a widow, a divorced woman, or a woman defiled by prostitution, but only a virgin from his own people,

21.zh: 不可在民中辱没他的儿女，因为我是叫他成圣的耶和华。
21.en: so he will not defile his offspring among his people. I am the Lord , who makes him holy. ' "

21.zh: 耶和华对摩西说：
21.en: The Lord said to Moses,

21.zh: 你告诉亚伦说：你世世代代的后裔，凡有残疾的，都不可近前来献他神的食物。
21.en: "Say to Aaron: 'For the generations to come none of your descendants who has a defect may come near to offer the food of his God.

21.zh: 因为凡有残疾的，无论是瞎眼的 、 瘸腿的 、 塌鼻子的 、 肢体有余的 、
21.en: No man who has any defect may come near: no man who is blind or lame, disfigured or deformed;

21.zh: 折脚折手的 、
21.en: no man with a crippled foot or hand,

21.zh: 驼背的 、 矮矬的 、 眼睛有毛病的 、 长癣的 、 长疥的，或是损坏肾子的，都不可近前来。
21.en: or who is hunchbacked or dwarfed, or who has any eye defect, or who has festering or running sores or damaged testicles.

21.zh: 祭司亚伦的后裔，凡有残疾的，都不可近前来，将火祭献给耶和华。他有残疾，不可近前来献神的食物。
21.en: No descendant of Aaron the priest who has any defect is to come near to present the offerings made to the Lord by fire. He has a defect; he must not come near to offer the food of his God.

21.zh: 神的食物，无论是圣的，至圣的，他都可以吃。
21.en: He may eat the most holy food of his God, as well as the holy food;

21.zh: 但不可进到幔子前，也不可就近坛前；因为他有残疾，免得亵渎我的圣所。我是叫他成圣的耶和华。
21.en: yet because of his defect, he must not go near the curtain or approach the altar, and so desecrate my sanctuary. I am the Lord , who makes them holy. ' "

21.zh: 于是，摩西晓谕亚伦和亚伦的子孙，并以色列众人。
21.en: So Moses told this to Aaron and his sons and to all the Israelites.

22.zh: 耶和华对摩西说：
22.en: The Lord said to Moses,

22.zh: 你吩咐亚伦和他子孙说：要远离以色列人所分别为圣 、 归给我的圣物，免得亵渎我的圣名。我是耶和华。
22.en: "Tell Aaron and his sons to treat with respect the sacred offerings the Israelites consecrate to me, so they will not profane my holy name. I am the Lord .

22.zh: 你要对他们说：你们世世代代的后裔，凡身上有污秽 、 亲近以色列人所分别为圣 、 归耶和华圣物的，那人必在我面前剪除。我是耶和华。
22.en: "Say to them: 'For the generations to come, if any of your descendants is ceremonially unclean and yet comes near the sacred offerings that the Israelites consecrate to the Lord , that person must be cut off from my presence. I am the Lord .

22.zh: 亚伦的后裔，凡长大痳疯的，或是有漏症的，不可吃圣物，直等他洁净了。无论谁摸那因死尸不洁净的物（物或作：人），或是遗精的人，
22.en: " 'If a descendant of Aaron has an infectious skin disease or a bodily discharge, he may not eat the sacred offerings until he is cleansed. He will also be unclean if he touches something defiled by a corpse or by anyone who has an emission of semen,

22.zh: 或是摸甚么使他不洁净的爬物，或是摸那使他不洁净的人（不拘那人有甚么不洁净），
22.en: or if he touches any crawling thing that makes him unclean, or any person who makes him unclean, whatever the uncleanness may be.

22.zh: 摸了这些人 、 物的，必不洁净到晚上；若不用水洗身，就不可吃圣物。
22.en: The one who touches any such thing will be unclean till evening. He must not eat any of the sacred offerings unless he has bathed himself with water.

22.zh: 日落的时候，他就洁净了，然后可以吃圣物，因为这是他的食物。
22.en: When the sun goes down, he will be clean, and after that he may eat the sacred offerings, for they are his food.

22.zh: 自死的或是被野兽撕裂的，他不可吃，因此污秽自己。我是耶和华。
22.en: He must not eat anything found dead or torn by wild animals, and so become unclean through it. I am the Lord .

22.zh: 所以他们要守我所吩咐的，免得轻忽了，因此担罪而死。我是叫他们成圣的耶和华。
22.en: " 'The priests are to keep my requirements so that they do not become guilty and die for treating them with contempt. I am the Lord , who makes them holy.

22.zh: 凡外人不可吃圣物；寄居在祭司家的，或是雇工人，都不可吃圣物；
22.en: " 'No one outside a priest's family may eat the sacred offering, nor may the guest of a priest or his hired worker eat it.

22.zh: 倘若祭司买人，是他的钱买的，那人就可以吃圣物；生在他家的人也可以吃。
22.en: But if a priest buys a slave with money, or if a slave is born in his household, that slave may eat his food.

22.zh: 祭司的女儿若嫁外人，就不可吃举祭的圣物。
22.en: If a priest's daughter marries anyone other than a priest, she may not eat any of the sacred contributions.

22.zh: 但祭司的女儿若是寡妇，或是被休的，没有孩子，又归回父家，与他青年一样，就可以吃他父亲的食物；只是外人不可吃。
22.en: But if a priest's daughter becomes a widow or is divorced, yet has no children, and she returns to live in her father's house as in her youth, she may eat of her father's food. No unauthorized person, however, may eat any of it.

22.zh: 若有人误吃了圣物，要照圣物的原数加上五分之一交给祭司。
22.en: " 'If anyone eats a sacred offering by mistake, he must make restitution to the priest for the offering and add a fifth of the value to it.

22.zh: 祭司不可亵渎以色列人所献给耶和华的圣物，
22.en: The priests must not desecrate the sacred offerings the Israelites present to the Lord

22.zh: 免得他们在吃圣物上自取罪孽，因为我是叫他们成圣的耶和华。
22.en: by allowing them to eat the sacred offerings and so bring upon them guilt requiring payment. I am the Lord , who makes them holy.' "

22.zh: 耶和华对摩西说：
22.en: The Lord said to Moses,

22.zh: 你晓谕亚伦和他子孙，并以色列众人说：以色列家中的人，或在以色列中寄居的，凡献供物，无论是所许的愿，是甘心献的，就是献给耶和华作燔祭的，
22.en: "Speak to Aaron and his sons and to all the Israelites and say to them: 'If any of you-either an Israelite or an alien living in Israel-presents a gift for a burnt offering to the Lord , either to fulfill a vow or as a freewill offering,

22.zh: 要将没有残疾的公牛，或是绵羊，或是山羊献上，如此方蒙悦纳。
22.en: you must present a male without defect from the cattle, sheep or goats in order that it may be accepted on your behalf.

22.zh: 凡有残疾的，你们不可献上，因为这不蒙悦纳。
22.en: Do not bring anything with a defect, because it will not be accepted on your behalf.

22.zh: 凡从牛群或是羊群中，将平安祭献给耶和华，为要还特许的愿，或是作甘心献的，所献的必纯全无残疾的才蒙悦纳。
22.en: When anyone brings from the herd or flock a fellowship offering to the Lord to fulfill a special vow or as a freewill offering, it must be without defect or blemish to be acceptable.

22.zh: 瞎眼的 、 折伤的 、 残废的 、 有瘤子的 、 长癣的 、 长疥的都不可献给耶和华，也不可在坛上作为火祭献给耶和华。
22.en: Do not offer to the Lord the blind, the injured or the maimed, or anything with warts or festering or running sores. Do not place any of these on the altar as an offering made to the Lord by fire.

22.zh: 无论是公牛是绵羊羔，若肢体有余的，或是缺少的，只可作甘心祭献上；用以还愿，却不蒙悦纳。
22.en: You may, however, present as a freewill offering an ox or a sheep that is deformed or stunted, but it will not be accepted in fulfillment of a vow.

22.zh: 肾子损伤的，或是压碎的，或是破裂的，或是骟了的，不可献给耶和华，在你们的地上也不可这样行。
22.en: You must not offer to the Lord an animal whose testicles are bruised, crushed, torn or cut. You must not do this in your own land,

22.zh: 这类的物，你们从外人的手，一样也不可接受作你们神的食物献上；因为这些都有损坏，有残疾，不蒙悦纳。
22.en: and you must not accept such animals from the hand of a foreigner and offer them as the food of your God. They will not be accepted on your behalf, because they are deformed and have defects.' "

22.zh: 耶和华晓谕摩西说：
22.en: The Lord said to Moses,

22.zh: 才生的公牛，或是绵羊或是山羊，七天当跟著母；从第八天以后，可以当供物蒙悦纳，作为耶和华的火祭。
22.en: "When a calf, a lamb or a goat is born, it is to remain with its mother for seven days. From the eighth day on, it will be acceptable as an offering made to the Lord by fire.

22.zh: 无论是母牛是母羊，不可同日宰母和子。
22.en: Do not slaughter a cow or a sheep and its young on the same day.

22.zh: 你们献感谢祭给耶和华，要献得可蒙悦纳。
22.en: "When you sacrifice a thank offering to the Lord , sacrifice it in such a way that it will be accepted on your behalf.

22.zh: 要当天吃，一点不可留到早晨。我是耶和华。
22.en: It must be eaten that same day; leave none of it till morning. I am the Lord .

22.zh: 你们要谨守遵行我的诫命。我是耶和华。
22.en: "Keep my commands and follow them. I am the Lord .

22.zh: 你们不可亵渎我的圣名；我在以色列人中，却要被尊为圣。我是叫你们成圣的耶和华，
22.en: Do not profane my holy name. I must be acknowledged as holy by the Israelites. I am the Lord , who makes you holy

22.zh: 把你们从埃及地领出来，作你们的神。我是耶和华。
22.en: and who brought you out of Egypt to be your God. I am the Lord ."

23.zh: 耶和华对摩西说：
23.en: The Lord said to Moses,

23.zh: 你晓谕以色列人说：耶和华的节期，你们要宣告为圣会的节期。
23.en: "Speak to the Israelites and say to them: 'These are my appointed feasts, the appointed feasts of the Lord , which you are to proclaim as sacred assemblies.

23.zh: 六日要做工，第七日是圣安息日，当有圣会；你们甚么工都不可做。这是在你们一切的住处向耶和华守的安息日。
23.en: " 'There are six days when you may work, but the seventh day is a Sabbath of rest, a day of sacred assembly. You are not to do any work; wherever you live, it is a Sabbath to the Lord .

23.zh: 耶和华的节期，就是你们到了日期要宣告为圣会的，乃是这些。
23.en: " 'These are the Lord 's appointed feasts, the sacred assemblies you are to proclaim at their appointed times:

23.zh: 正月十四日，黄昏的时候，是耶和华的逾越节。
23.en: The Lord 's Passover begins at twilight on the fourteenth day of the first month.

23.zh: 这月十五日是向耶和华守的无酵节；你们要吃无酵饼七日。
23.en: On the fifteenth day of that month the Lord 's Feast of Unleavened Bread begins; for seven days you must eat bread made without yeast.

23.zh: 第一日当有圣会，甚么劳碌的工都不可做；
23.en: On the first day hold a sacred assembly and do no regular work.

23.zh: 要将火祭献给耶和华七日。第七日是圣会，甚么劳碌的工都不可做。
23.en: For seven days present an offering made to the Lord by fire. And on the seventh day hold a sacred assembly and do no regular work.' "

23.zh: 耶和华对摩西说：
23.en: The Lord said to Moses,

23.zh: 你晓谕以色列人说：你们到了我赐给你们的地，收割庄稼的时候，要将初熟的庄稼一捆带给祭司。
23.en: "Speak to the Israelites and say to them: 'When you enter the land I am going to give you and you reap its harvest, bring to the priest a sheaf of the first grain you harvest.

23.zh: 他要把这一捆在耶和华面前摇一摇，使你们得蒙悦纳。祭司要在安息日的次日把这捆摇一摇。
23.en: He is to wave the sheaf before the Lord so it will be accepted on your behalf; the priest is to wave it on the day after the Sabbath.

23.zh: 摇这捆的日子，你们要把一岁 、 没有残疾的公绵羊羔献给耶和华为燔祭。
23.en: On the day you wave the sheaf, you must sacrifice as a burnt offering to the Lord a lamb a year old without defect,

23.zh: 同献的素祭，就是调油的细面伊法十分之二，作为馨香的火祭，献给耶和华。同献的奠祭，要酒一欣四分之一。
23.en: together with its grain offering of two-tenths of an ephah of fine flour mixed with oil-an offering made to the Lord by fire, a pleasing aroma-and its drink offering of a quarter of a hin of wine.

23.zh: 无论是饼，是烘的子粒，是新穗子，你们都不可吃，直等到把你们献给神的供物带来的那一天才可以吃。这在你们一切的住处作为世世代代永远的定例。
23.en: You must not eat any bread, or roasted or new grain, until the very day you bring this offering to your God. This is to be a lasting ordinance for the generations to come, wherever you live.

23.zh: 你们要从安息日的次日，献禾捆为摇祭的那日算起，要满了七个安息日。
23.en: " 'From the day after the Sabbath, the day you brought the sheaf of the wave offering, count off seven full weeks.

23.zh: 到第七个安息日的次日，共计五十天，又要将新素祭献给耶和华。
23.en: Count off fifty days up to the day after the seventh Sabbath, and then present an offering of new grain to the Lord .

23.zh: 要从你们的住处取出细面伊法十分之二，加酵，烤成两个摇祭的饼，当作初熟之物献给耶和华。
23.en: From wherever you live, bring two loaves made of two-tenths of an ephah of fine flour, baked with yeast, as a wave offering of firstfruits to the Lord .

23.zh: 又要将一岁 、 没有残疾的羊羔七只 、 公牛犊一只 、 公绵羊两只，和饼一同奉上。这些与同献的素祭和奠祭要作为燔祭献给耶和华，就是作馨香的火祭献给耶和华。
23.en: Present with this bread seven male lambs, each a year old and without defect, one young bull and two rams. They will be a burnt offering to the Lord , together with their grain offerings and drink offerings-an offering made by fire, an aroma pleasing to the Lord .

23.zh: 你们要献一只公山羊为赎罪祭，两只一岁的公绵羊羔为平安祭。
23.en: Then sacrifice one male goat for a sin offering and two lambs, each a year old, for a fellowship offering.

23.zh: 祭司要把这些和初熟麦子做的饼一同作摇祭，在耶和华面前摇一摇；这是献与耶和华为圣物归给祭司的。
23.en: The priest is to wave the two lambs before the Lord as a wave offering, together with the bread of the firstfruits. They are a sacred offering to the Lord for the priest.

23.zh: 当这日，你们要宣告圣会；甚么劳碌的工都不可做。这在你们一切的住处作为世世代代永远的定例。
23.en: On that same day you are to proclaim a sacred assembly and do no regular work. This is to be a lasting ordinance for the generations to come, wherever you live.

23.zh: 在你们的地收割庄稼，不可割尽田角，也不可拾取所遗落的；要留给穷人和寄居的。我是耶和华 ─ 你们的神。
23.en: " 'When you reap the harvest of your land, do not reap to the very edges of your field or gather the gleanings of your harvest. Leave them for the poor and the alien. I am the Lord your God.' "

23.zh: 耶和华对摩西说：
23.en: The Lord said to Moses,

23.zh: 你晓谕以色列人说：七月初一，你们要守为圣安息日，要吹角作纪念，当有圣会。
23.en: "Say to the Israelites: 'On the first day of the seventh month you are to have a day of rest, a sacred assembly commemorated with trumpet blasts.

23.zh: 甚么劳碌的工都不可做；要将火祭献给耶和华。
23.en: Do no regular work, but present an offering made to the Lord by fire.' "

23.zh: 耶和华晓谕摩西说：
23.en: The Lord said to Moses,

23.zh: 七月初十是赎罪日；你们要守为圣会，并要刻苦己心，也要将火祭献给耶和华。
23.en: "The tenth day of this seventh month is the Day of Atonement. Hold a sacred assembly and deny yourselves, and present an offering made to the Lord by fire.

23.zh: 当这日，甚么工都不可做；因为是赎罪日，要在耶和华 ─ 你们的神面前赎罪。
23.en: Do no work on that day, because it is the Day of Atonement, when atonement is made for you before the Lord your God.

23.zh: 当这日，凡不刻苦己心的，必从民中剪除。
23.en: Anyone who does not deny himself on that day must be cut off from his people.

23.zh: 凡这日做甚么工的，我必将他从民中除灭。
23.en: I will destroy from among his people anyone who does any work on that day.

23.zh: 你们甚么工都不可做。这在你们一切的住处作为世世代代永远的定例。
23.en: You shall do no work at all. This is to be a lasting ordinance for the generations to come, wherever you live.

23.zh: 你们要守这日为圣安息日，并要刻苦己心。从这月初九日晚上到次日晚上，要守为安息日。
23.en: It is a sabbath of rest for you, and you must deny yourselves. From the evening of the ninth day of the month until the following evening you are to observe your sabbath."

23.zh: 耶和华对摩西说：
23.en: The Lord said to Moses,

23.zh: 你晓谕以色列人说：这七月十五日是住棚节，要在耶和华面前守这节七日。
23.en: "Say to the Israelites: 'On the fifteenth day of the seventh month the Lord 's Feast of Tabernacles begins, and it lasts for seven days.

23.zh: 第一日当有圣会，甚么劳碌的工都不可做。
23.en: The first day is a sacred assembly; do no regular work.

23.zh: 七日内要将火祭献给耶和华。第八日当守圣会，要将火祭献给耶和华。这是严肃会，甚么劳碌的工都不可做。
23.en: For seven days present offerings made to the Lord by fire, and on the eighth day hold a sacred assembly and present an offering made to the Lord by fire. It is the closing assembly; do no regular work.

23.zh: 这是耶和华的节期，就是你们要宣告为圣会的节期；要将火祭 、 燔祭 、 素祭 、 祭物，并奠祭，各归各日，献给耶和华。
23.en: (" 'These are the Lord 's appointed feasts, which you are to proclaim as sacred assemblies for bringing offerings made to the Lord by fire-the burnt offerings and grain offerings, sacrifices and drink offerings required for each day.

23.zh: 这是在耶和华的安息日以外，又在你们的供物和所许的愿，并甘心献给耶和华的以外。
23.en: These offerings are in addition to those for the Lord 's Sabbaths and in addition to your gifts and whatever you have vowed and all the freewill offerings you give to the Lord .)

23.zh: 你们收藏了地的出产，就从七月十五日起，要守耶和华的节七日。第一日为圣安息；第八日也为圣安息。
23.en: " 'So beginning with the fifteenth day of the seventh month, after you have gathered the crops of the land, celebrate the festival to the Lord for seven days; the first day is a day of rest, and the eighth day also is a day of rest.

23.zh: 第一日要拿美好树上的果子和棕树上的枝子，与茂密树的枝条并河旁的柳枝，在耶和华 ─ 你们的神面前欢乐七日。
23.en: On the first day you are to take choice fruit from the trees, and palm fronds, leafy branches and poplars, and rejoice before the Lord your God for seven days.

23.zh: 每年七月间，要向耶和华守这节七日。这为你们世世代代永远的定例。
23.en: Celebrate this as a festival to the Lord for seven days each year. This is to be a lasting ordinance for the generations to come; celebrate it in the seventh month.

23.zh: 你们要住在棚里七日；凡以色列家的人都要住在棚里，
23.en: Live in booths for seven days: All native-born Israelites are to live in booths

23.zh: 好叫你们世世代代知道，我领以色列人出埃及地的时候曾使他们住在棚里。我是耶和华 ─ 你们的神。
23.en: so your descendants will know that I had the Israelites live in booths when I brought them out of Egypt. I am the Lord your God.' "

23.zh: 于是，摩西将耶和华的节期传给以色列人。
23.en: So Moses announced to the Israelites the appointed feasts of the Lord .

24.zh: 耶和华晓谕摩西说：
24.en: The Lord said to Moses,

24.zh: 要吩咐以色列人，把那为点灯捣成的清橄榄油拿来给你，使灯常常点著。
24.en: "Command the Israelites to bring you clear oil of pressed olives for the light so that the lamps may be kept burning continually.

24.zh: 在会幕中法柜的幔子外，亚伦从晚上到早晨必在耶和华面前经理这灯。这要作你们世世代代永远的定例。
24.en: Outside the curtain of the Testimony in the Tent of Meeting, Aaron is to tend the lamps before the Lord from evening till morning, continually. This is to be a lasting ordinance for the generations to come.

24.zh: 他要在耶和华面前常收拾精金灯台上的灯。
24.en: The lamps on the pure gold lampstand before the Lord must be tended continually.

24.zh: 你要取细面，烤成十二个饼，每饼用面伊法十分之二。
24.en: "Take fine flour and bake twelve loaves of bread, using two-tenths of an ephah for each loaf.

24.zh: 要把饼摆列两行（或作：摞；下同），每行六个，在耶和华面前精金的桌子上；
24.en: Set them in two rows, six in each row, on the table of pure gold before the Lord .

24.zh: 又要把净乳香放在每行饼上，作为纪念，就是作为火祭献给耶和华。
24.en: Along each row put some pure incense as a memorial portion to represent the bread and to be an offering made to the Lord by fire.

24.zh: 每安息日要常摆在耶和华面前；这为以色列人作永远的约。
24.en: This bread is to be set out before the Lord regularly, Sabbath after Sabbath, on behalf of the Israelites, as a lasting covenant.

24.zh: 这饼是要给亚伦和他子孙的；他们要在圣处吃，为永远的定例，因为在献给耶和华的火祭中是至圣的。
24.en: It belongs to Aaron and his sons, who are to eat it in a holy place, because it is a most holy part of their regular share of the offerings made to the Lord by fire." A Blasphemer Stoned

24.zh: 有一个以色列妇人的儿子，他父亲是埃及人，一日闲游在以色列人中。这以色列妇人的儿子和一个以色列人在营里争斗。
24.en: Now the son of an Israelite mother and an Egyptian father went out among the Israelites, and a fight broke out in the camp between him and an Israelite.

24.zh: 这以色列妇人的儿子亵渎了圣名，并且咒诅，就有人把他送到摩西那里。（他母亲名叫示罗密，是但支派底伯利的女儿。）
24.en: The son of the Israelite woman blasphemed the Name with a curse; so they brought him to Moses. (His mother's name was Shelomith, the daughter of Dibri the Danite.)

24.zh: 他们把那人收在监里，要得耶和华所指示的话。
24.en: They put him in custody until the will of the Lord should be made clear to them.

24.zh: 耶和华晓谕摩西说：
24.en: Then the Lord said to Moses:

24.zh: 把那咒诅圣名的人带到营外。叫听见的人都放手在他头上；全会众就要用石头打死他。
24.en: "Take the blasphemer outside the camp. All those who heard him are to lay their hands on his head, and the entire assembly is to stone him.

24.zh: 你要晓谕以色列人说：凡咒诅神的，必担当他的罪。
24.en: Say to the Israelites: 'If anyone curses his God, he will be held responsible;

24.zh: 那亵渎耶和华名的，必被治死；全会众总要用石头打死他。不管是寄居的是本地人，他亵渎耶和华名的时候，必被治死。
24.en: anyone who blasphemes the name of the Lord must be put to death. The entire assembly must stone him. Whether an alien or native-born, when he blasphemes the Name, he must be put to death.

24.zh: 打死人的，必被治死；
24.en: " 'If anyone takes the life of a human being, he must be put to death.

24.zh: 打死牲畜的，必赔上牲畜，以命偿命。
24.en: Anyone who takes the life of someone's animal must make restitution-life for life.

24.zh: 人若使他邻舍的身体有残疾，他怎样行，也要照样向他行：
24.en: If anyone injures his neighbor, whatever he has done must be done to him:

24.zh: 以伤还伤，以眼还眼，以牙还牙。他怎样叫人的身体有残疾，也要照样向他行。
24.en: fracture for fracture, eye for eye, tooth for tooth. As he has injured the other, so he is to be injured.

24.zh: 打死牲畜的，必赔上牲畜；打死人的，必被治死。
24.en: Whoever kills an animal must make restitution, but whoever kills a man must be put to death.

24.zh: 不管是寄居的是本地人，同归一例。我是耶和华 ─ 你们的神。
24.en: You are to have the same law for the alien and the native-born. I am the Lord your God.' "

24.zh: 于是，摩西晓谕以色列人，他们就把那咒诅圣名的人带到营外，用石头打死。以色列人就照耶和华所吩咐摩西的行了。
24.en: Then Moses spoke to the Israelites, and they took the blasphemer outside the camp and stoned him. The Israelites did as the Lord commanded Moses.

25.zh: 耶和华在西乃山对摩西说：
25.en: The Lord said to Moses on MountSinai,

25.zh: 你晓谕以色列人说：你们到了我所赐你们那地的时候，地就要向耶和华守安息。
25.en: "Speak to the Israelites and say to them: 'When you enter the land I am going to give you, the land itself must observe a sabbath to the Lord .

25.zh: 六年要耕种田地，也要修理葡萄园，收藏地的出产。
25.en: For six years sow your fields, and for six years prune your vineyards and gather their crops.

25.zh: 第七年，地要守圣安息，就是向耶和华守的安息，不可耕种田地，也不可修理葡萄园。
25.en: But in the seventh year the land is to have a sabbath of rest, a sabbath to the Lord . Do not sow your fields or prune your vineyards.

25.zh: 遗落自长的庄稼不可收割；没有修理的葡萄树也不可摘取葡萄。这年，地要守圣安息。
25.en: Do not reap what grows of itself or harvest the grapes of your untended vines. The land is to have a year of rest.

25.zh: 地在安息年所出的，要给你和你的仆人 、 婢女 、 雇工人，并寄居的外人当食物。
25.en: Whatever the land yields during the sabbath year will be food for you-for yourself, your manservant and maidservant, and the hired worker and temporary resident who live among you,

25.zh: 这年的土产也要给你的牲畜和你地上的走兽当食物。
25.en: as well as for your livestock and the wild animals in your land. Whatever the land produces may be eaten.

25.zh: 你要计算七个安息年，就是七七年。这便为你成了七个安息年，共是四十九年。
25.en: " 'Count off seven sabbaths of years-seven times seven years-so that the seven sabbaths of years amount to a period of forty-nine years.

25.zh: 当年七月初十日，你要大发角声；这日就是赎罪日，要在遍地发出角声。
25.en: Then have the trumpet sounded everywhere on the tenth day of the seventh month; on the Day of Atonement sound the trumpet throughout your land.

25.zh: 第五十年，你们要当作圣年，在遍地给一切的居民宣告自由。这年必为你们的禧年，各人要归自己的产业，各归本家。
25.en: Consecrate the fiftieth year and proclaim liberty throughout the land to all its inhabitants. It shall be a jubilee for you; each one of you is to return to his family property and each to his own clan.

25.zh: 第五十年要作为你们的禧年。这年不可耕种；地中自长的，不可收割；没有修理的葡萄树也不可摘取葡萄。
25.en: The fiftieth year shall be a jubilee for you; do not sow and do not reap what grows of itself or harvest the untended vines.

25.zh: 因为这是禧年，你们要当作圣年，吃地中自出的土产。
25.en: For it is a jubilee and is to be holy for you; eat only what is taken directly from the fields.

25.zh: 这禧年，你们各人要归自己的地业。
25.en: " 'In this Year of Jubilee everyone is to return to his own property.

25.zh: 你若卖甚么给邻舍，或是从邻舍的手中买甚么，彼此不可亏负。
25.en: " 'If you sell land to one of your countrymen or buy any from him, do not take advantage of each other.

25.zh: 你要按禧年以后的年数向邻舍买；他也要按年数的收成卖给你。
25.en: You are to buy from your countryman on the basis of the number of years since the Jubilee. And he is to sell to you on the basis of the number of years left for harvesting crops.

25.zh: 年岁若多，要照数加添价值；年岁若少，要照数减去价值，因为他照收成的数目卖给你。
25.en: When the years are many, you are to increase the price, and when the years are few, you are to decrease the price, because what he is really selling you is the number of crops.

25.zh: 你们彼此不可亏负，只要敬畏你们的神，因为我是耶和华 ─ 你们的神。
25.en: Do not take advantage of each other, but fear your God. I am the Lord your God.

25.zh: 我的律例，你们要遵行，我的典章，你们要谨守，就可以在那地上安然居住。
25.en: " 'Follow my decrees and be careful to obey my laws, and you will live safely in the land.

25.zh: 地必出土产，你们就要吃饱，在那地上安然居住。
25.en: Then the land will yield its fruit, and you will eat your fill and live there in safety.

25.zh: 你们若说：这第七年我们不耕种，也不收藏土产，吃甚么呢？
25.en: You may ask, "What will we eat in the seventh year if we do not plant or harvest our crops?"

25.zh: 我必在第六年将我所命的福赐给你们，地便生三年的土产。
25.en: I will send you such a blessing in the sixth year that the land will yield enough for three years.

25.zh: 第八年，你们要耕种，也要吃陈粮，等到第九年出产收来的时候，你们还吃陈粮。
25.en: While you plant during the eighth year, you will eat from the old crop and will continue to eat from it until the harvest of the ninth year comes in.

25.zh: 地不可永卖，因为地是我的；你们在我面前是客旅，是寄居的。
25.en: " 'The land must not be sold permanently, because the land is mine and you are but aliens and my tenants.

25.zh: 在你们所得为业的全地，也要准人将地赎回。
25.en: Throughout the country that you hold as a possession, you must provide for the redemption of the land.

25.zh: 你的弟兄（弟兄是指本国人说；下同）若渐渐穷乏，卖了几分地业，他至近的亲属就要来把弟兄所卖的赎回。
25.en: " 'If one of your countrymen becomes poor and sells some of his property, his nearest relative is to come and redeem what his countryman has sold.

25.zh: 若没有能给他赎回的，他自己渐渐富足，能够赎回，
25.en: If, however, a man has no one to redeem it for him but he himself prospers and acquires sufficient means to redeem it,

25.zh: 就要算出卖地的年数，把余剩年数的价值还那买主，自己便归回自己的地业。
25.en: he is to determine the value for the years since he sold it and refund the balance to the man to whom he sold it; he can then go back to his own property.

25.zh: 倘若不能为自己得回所卖的，仍要存在买主的手里直到禧年；到了禧年，地业要出买主的手，自己便归回自己的地业。
25.en: But if he does not acquire the means to repay him, what he sold will remain in the possession of the buyer until the Year of Jubilee. It will be returned in the Jubilee, and he can then go back to his property.

25.zh: 人若卖城内的住宅，卖了以后，一年之内可以赎回；在一整年，必有赎回的权柄。
25.en: " 'If a man sells a house in a walled city, he retains the right of redemption a full year after its sale. During that time he may redeem it.

25.zh: 若在一整年之内不赎回，这城内的房屋就定准永归买主，世世代代为业；在禧年也不得出买主的手。
25.en: If it is not redeemed before a full year has passed, the house in the walled city shall belong permanently to the buyer and his descendants. It is not to be returned in the Jubilee.

25.zh: 但房屋在无城墙的村庄里，要看如乡下的田地一样，可以赎回；到了禧年，都要出买主的手。
25.en: But houses in villages without walls around them are to be considered as open country. They can be redeemed, and they are to be returned in the Jubilee.

25.zh: 然而利未人所得为业的城邑，其中的房屋，利未人可以随时赎回。
25.en: " 'The Levites always have the right to redeem their houses in the Levitical towns, which they possess.

25.zh: 若是一个利未人不将所卖的房屋赎回，是在所得为业的城内，到了禧年就要出买主的手，因为利未人城邑的房屋是他们在以色列人中的产业。
25.en: So the property of the Levites is redeemable-that is, a house sold in any town they hold-and is to be returned in the Jubilee, because the houses in the towns of the Levites are their property among the Israelites.

25.zh: 只是他们各城郊野之地不可卖，因为是他们永远的产业。
25.en: But the pastureland belonging to their towns must not be sold; it is their permanent possession.

25.zh: 你的弟兄在你那里若渐渐贫穷，手中缺乏，你就要帮补他，使他与你同住，像外人和寄居的一样。
25.en: " 'If one of your countrymen becomes poor and is unable to support himself among you, help him as you would an alien or a temporary resident, so he can continue to live among you.

25.zh: 不可向他取利，也不可向他多要；只要敬畏你的神，使你的弟兄与你同住。
25.en: Do not take interest of any kind from him, but fear your God, so that your countryman may continue to live among you.

25.zh: 你借钱给他，不可向他取利；借粮给他，也不可向他多要。
25.en: You must not lend him money at interest or sell him food at a profit.

25.zh: 我是耶和华 ─ 你们的神，曾领你们从埃及地出来，为要把迦南地赐给你们，要作你们的神。
25.en: I am the Lord your God, who brought you out of Egypt to give you the land of Canaan and to be your God.

25.zh: 你的弟兄若在你那里渐渐穷乏，将自己卖给你，不可叫他像奴仆服事你。
25.en: " 'If one of your countrymen becomes poor among you and sells himself to you, do not make him work as a slave.

25.zh: 他要在你那里像雇工人和寄居的一样，要服事你直到禧年。
25.en: He is to be treated as a hired worker or a temporary resident among you; he is to work for you until the Year of Jubilee.

25.zh: 到了禧年，他和他儿女要离开你，一同出去归回本家，到他祖宗的地业那里去。
25.en: Then he and his children are to be released, and he will go back to his own clan and to the property of his forefathers.

25.zh: 因为他们是我的仆人，是我从埃及地领出来的，不可卖为奴仆。
25.en: Because the Israelites are my servants, whom I brought out of Egypt, they must not be sold as slaves.

25.zh: 不可严严的辖管他，只要敬畏你的神。
25.en: Do not rule over them ruthlessly, but fear your God.

25.zh: 至于你的奴仆 、 婢女，可以从你四围的国中买。
25.en: " 'Your male and female slaves are to come from the nations around you; from them you may buy slaves.

25.zh: 并且那寄居在你们中间的外人和他们的家属，在你们地上所生的，你们也可以从其中买人；他们要作你们的产业。
25.en: You may also buy some of the temporary residents living among you and members of their clans born in your country, and they will become your property.

25.zh: 你们要将他们遗留给你们的子孙为产业，要永远从他们中间拣出奴仆；只是你们的弟兄以色列人，你们不可严严的辖管。
25.en: You can will them to your children as inherited property and can make them slaves for life, but you must not rule over your fellow Israelites ruthlessly.

25.zh: 住在你那里的外人，或是寄居的，若渐渐富足，你的弟兄却渐渐穷乏，将自己卖给那外人，或是寄居的，或是外人的宗族，
25.en: " 'If an alien or a temporary resident among you becomes rich and one of your countrymen becomes poor and sells himself to the alien living among you or to a member of the alien's clan,

25.zh: 卖了以后，可以将他赎回。无论是他的弟兄，
25.en: he retains the right of redemption after he has sold himself. One of his relatives may redeem him:

25.zh: 或伯叔 、 伯叔的儿子，本家的近支，都可以赎他。他自己若渐渐富足，也可以自赎。
25.en: An uncle or a cousin or any blood relative in his clan may redeem him. Or if he prospers, he may redeem himself.

25.zh: 他要和买主计算，从卖自己的那年起，算到禧年；所卖的价值照著年数多少，好像工人每年的工价。
25.en: He and his buyer are to count the time from the year he sold himself up to the Year of Jubilee. The price for his release is to be based on the rate paid to a hired man for that number of years.

25.zh: 若缺少的年数多，就要按著年数从买价中偿还他的赎价
25.en: If many years remain, he must pay for his redemption a larger share of the price paid for him.

25.zh: 若到禧年只缺少几年，就要按著年数和买主计算，偿还他的赎价。
25.en: If only a few years remain until the Year of Jubilee, he is to compute that and pay for his redemption accordingly.

25.zh: 他和买主同住，要像每年雇的工人，买主不可严严的辖管他。
25.en: He is to be treated as a man hired from year to year; you must see to it that his owner does not rule over him ruthlessly.

25.zh: 他若不这样被赎，到了禧年，要和他的儿女一同出去。
25.en: " 'Even if he is not redeemed in any of these ways, he and his children are to be released in the Year of Jubilee,

25.zh: 因为以色列人都是我的仆人，是我从埃及地领出来的。我是耶和华 ─ 你们的神。
25.en: for the Israelites belong to me as servants. They are my servants, whom I brought out of Egypt. I am the Lord your God.

26.zh: 你们不可做甚么虚无的神像，不可立雕刻的偶像或是柱像，也不可在你们的地上安甚么錾成的石像，向他跪拜，因为我是耶和华 ─ 你们的神。
26.en: " 'Do not make idols or set up an image or a sacred stone for yourselves, and do not place a carved stone in your land to bow down before it. I am the Lord your God.

26.zh: 你们要守我的安息日，敬我的圣所。我是耶和华。
26.en: " 'Observe my Sabbaths and have reverence for my sanctuary. I am the Lord .

26.zh: 你们若遵行我的律例，谨守我的诫命，
26.en: " 'If you follow my decrees and are careful to obey my commands,

26.zh: 我就给你们降下时雨，叫地生出土产，田野的树木结果子。
26.en: I will send you rain in its season, and the ground will yield its crops and the trees of the field their fruit.

26.zh: 你们打粮食要打到摘葡萄的时候，摘葡萄要摘到撒种的时候；并且要吃得饱足，在你们的地上安然居住。
26.en: Your threshing will continue until grape harvest and the grape harvest will continue until planting, and you will eat all the food you want and live in safety in your land.

26.zh: 我要赐平安在你们的地上；你们躺卧，无人惊吓。我要叫恶兽从你们的地上息灭；刀剑也必不经过你们的地。
26.en: " 'I will grant peace in the land, and you will lie down and no one will make you afraid. I will remove savage beasts from the land, and the sword will not pass through your country.

26.zh: 你们要追赶仇敌，他们必倒在你们刀下。
26.en: You will pursue your enemies, and they will fall by the sword before you.

26.zh: 你们五个人要追赶一百人，一百人要追赶一万人；仇敌必倒在你们刀下。
26.en: Five of you will chase a hundred, and a hundred of you will chase ten thousand, and your enemies will fall by the sword before you.

26.zh: 我要眷顾你们，使你们生养众多，也要与你们坚定所立的约。
26.en: " 'I will look on you with favor and make you fruitful and increase your numbers, and I will keep my covenant with you.

26.zh: 你们要吃陈粮，又因新粮挪开陈粮。
26.en: You will still be eating last year's harvest when you will have to move it out to make room for the new.

26.zh: 我要在你们中间立我的帐幕；我的心也不厌恶你们。
26.en: I will put my dwelling place among you, and I will not abhor you.

26.zh: 我要在你们中间行走；我要作你们的神，你们要作我的子民。
26.en: I will walk among you and be your God, and you will be my people.

26.zh: 我是耶和华 ─ 你们的神，曾将你们从埃及地领出来，使你们不作埃及人的奴仆；我也折断你们所负的轭，叫你们挺身而走。
26.en: I am the Lord your God, who brought you out of Egypt so that you would no longer be slaves to the Egyptians; I broke the bars of your yoke and enabled you to walk with heads held high.

26.zh: 你们若不听从我，不遵行我的诫命，
26.en: " 'But if you will not listen to me and carry out all these commands,

26.zh: 厌弃我的律例，厌恶我的典章，不遵行我一切的诫命，背弃我的约，
26.en: and if you reject my decrees and abhor my laws and fail to carry out all my commands and so violate my covenant,

26.zh: 我待你们就要这样：我必命定惊惶，叫眼目干瘪 、 精神消耗的痨病热病辖制你们。你们也要白白的撒种，因为仇敌要吃你们所种的。
26.en: then I will do this to you: I will bring upon you sudden terror, wasting diseases and fever that will destroy your sight and drain away your life. You will plant seed in vain, because your enemies will eat it.

26.zh: 我要向你们变脸，你们就要败在仇敌面前。恨恶你们的，必辖管你们；无人追赶，你们却要逃跑。
26.en: I will set my face against you so that you will be defeated by your enemies; those who hate you will rule over you, and you will flee even when no one is pursuing you.

26.zh: 你们因这些事若还不听从我，我就要为你们的罪加七倍惩罚你们。
26.en: " 'If after all this you will not listen to me, I will punish you for your sins seven times over.

26.zh: 我必断绝你们因势力而有的骄傲，又要使覆你们的天如铁，载你们的地如铜。
26.en: I will break down your stubborn pride and make the sky above you like iron and the ground beneath you like bronze.

26.zh: 你们要白白的劳力；因为你们的地不出土产，其上的树木也不结果子。
26.en: Your strength will be spent in vain, because your soil will not yield its crops, nor will the trees of the land yield their fruit.

26.zh: 你们行事若与我反对，不肯听从我，我就要按你们的罪加七倍降灾与你们。
26.en: " 'If you remain hostile toward me and refuse to listen to me, I will multiply your afflictions seven times over, as your sins deserve.

26.zh: 我也要打发野地的走兽到你们中间，抢吃你们的儿女，吞灭你们的牲畜，使你们的人数减少，道路荒凉。
26.en: I will send wild animals against you, and they will rob you of your children, destroy your cattle and make you so few in number that your roads will be deserted.

26.zh: 你们因这些事若仍不改正归我，行事与我反对，
26.en: " 'If in spite of these things you do not accept my correction but continue to be hostile toward me,

26.zh: 我就要行事与你们反对，因你们的罪击打你们七次。
26.en: I myself will be hostile toward you and will afflict you for your sins seven times over.

26.zh: 我又要使刀剑临到你们，报复你们背约的仇；聚集你们在各城内，降瘟疫在你们中间，也必将你们交在仇敌的手中。
26.en: And I will bring the sword upon you to avenge the breaking of the covenant. When you withdraw into your cities, I will send a plague among you, and you will be given into enemy hands.

26.zh: 我要折断你们的杖，就是断绝你们的粮。那时，必有十个女人在一个炉子给你们烤饼，按分量秤给你们；你们要吃，也吃不饱。
26.en: When I cut off your supply of bread, ten women will be able to bake your bread in one oven, and they will dole out the bread by weight. You will eat, but you will not be satisfied.

26.zh: 你们因这一切的事若不听从我，却行事与我反对，
26.en: " 'If in spite of this you still do not listen to me but continue to be hostile toward me,

26.zh: 我就要发烈怒，行事与你们反对，又因你们的罪惩罚你们七次。
26.en: then in my anger I will be hostile toward you, and I myself will punish you for your sins seven times over.

26.zh: 并且你们要吃儿子的肉，也要吃女儿的肉。
26.en: You will eat the flesh of your sons and the flesh of your daughters.

26.zh: 我又要毁坏你们的邱坛，砍下你们的日像，把你们的尸首扔在你们偶像的身上；我的心也必厌恶你们。
26.en: I will destroy your high places, cut down your incense altars and pile your dead bodies on the lifeless forms of your idols, and I will abhor you.

26.zh: 我要使你们的城邑变为荒凉，使你们的众圣所成为荒场；我也不闻你们馨香的香气。
26.en: I will turn your cities into ruins and lay waste your sanctuaries, and I will take no delight in the pleasing aroma of your offerings.

26.zh: 我要使地成为荒场，住在其上的仇敌就因此诧异。
26.en: I will lay waste the land, so that your enemies who live there will be appalled.

26.zh: 我要把你们散在列邦中；我也要拔刀追赶你们。你们的地要成为荒场；你们的城邑要变为荒凉。
26.en: I will scatter you among the nations and will draw out my sword and pursue you. Your land will be laid waste, and your cities will lie in ruins.

26.zh: 你们在仇敌之地居住的时候，你们的地荒凉，要享受众安息；正在那时候，地要歇息，享受安息。
26.en: Then the land will enjoy its sabbath years all the time that it lies desolate and you are in the country of your enemies; then the land will rest and enjoy its sabbaths.

26.zh: 地多时为荒场，就要多时歇息；地这样歇息，是你们住在其上的安息年所不能得的。
26.en: All the time that it lies desolate, the land will have the rest it did not have during the sabbaths you lived in it.

26.zh: 至于你们剩下的人，我要使他们在仇敌之地心惊胆怯。叶子被风吹的响声，要追赶他们；他们要逃避，像人逃避刀剑，无人追赶，却要跌倒。
26.en: " 'As for those of you who are left, I will make their hearts so fearful in the lands of their enemies that the sound of a windblown leaf will put them to flight. They will run as though fleeing from the sword, and they will fall, even though no one is pursuing them.

26.zh: 无人追赶，他们要彼此撞跌，像在刀剑之前。你们在仇敌面前也必站立不住。
26.en: They will stumble over one another as though fleeing from the sword, even though no one is pursuing them. So you will not be able to stand before your enemies.

26.zh: 你们要在列邦中灭亡；仇敌之地要吞吃你们。
26.en: You will perish among the nations; the land of your enemies will devour you.

26.zh: 你们剩下的人必因自己的罪孽和祖宗的罪孽在仇敌之地消灭。
26.en: Those of you who are left will waste away in the lands of their enemies because of their sins; also because of their fathers' sins they will waste away.

26.zh: 他们要承认自己的罪和他们祖宗的罪，就是干犯我的那罪，并且承认自己行事与我反对，
26.en: " 'But if they will confess their sins and the sins of their fathers-their treachery against me and their hostility toward me,

26.zh: 我所以行事与他们反对，把他们带到仇敌之地。那时，他们未受割礼的心若谦卑了，他们也服了罪孽的刑罚，
26.en: which made me hostile toward them so that I sent them into the land of their enemies-then when their uncircumcised hearts are humbled and they pay for their sin,

26.zh: 我就要记念我与雅各所立的约，与以撒所立的约，与亚伯拉罕所立的约，并要记念这地。
26.en: I will remember my covenant with Jacob and my covenant with Isaac and my covenant with Abraham, and I will remember the land.

26.zh: 他们离开这地，地在荒废无人的时候就要享受安息。并且他们要服罪孽的刑罚；因为他们厌弃了我的典章，心中厌恶了我的律例。
26.en: For the land will be deserted by them and will enjoy its sabbaths while it lies desolate without them. They will pay for their sins because they rejected my laws and abhorred my decrees.

26.zh: 虽是这样，他们在仇敌之地，我却不厌弃他们，也不厌恶他们，将他们尽行灭绝，也不背弃我与他们所立的约，因为我是耶和华 ─ 他们的神。
26.en: Yet in spite of this, when they are in the land of their enemies, I will not reject them or abhor them so as to destroy them completely, breaking my covenant with them. I am the Lord their God.

26.zh: 我却要为他们的缘故记念我与他们先祖所立的约。他们的先祖是我在列邦人眼前 、 从埃及地领出来的，为要作他们的神。我是耶和华。
26.en: But for their sake I will remember the covenant with their ancestors whom I brought out of Egypt in the sight of the nations to be their God. I am the Lord .' "

26.zh: 这些律例 、 典章，和法度是耶和华与以色列人在西乃山藉著摩西立的。
26.en: These are the decrees, the laws and the regulations that the Lord established on Mount Sinai between himself and the Israelites through Moses.

27.zh: 耶和华对摩西说：
27.en: The Lord said to Moses,

27.zh: 你晓谕以色列人说：人还特许的愿，被许的人要按你所估的价值归给耶和华。
27.en: "Speak to the Israelites and say to them: 'If anyone makes a special vow to dedicate persons to the Lord by giving equivalent values,

27.zh: 你估定的，从二十岁到六十岁的男人，要按圣所的平，估定价银五十舍客勒。
27.en: set the value of a male between the ages of twenty and sixty at fifty shekels of silver, according to the sanctuary shekel ;

27.zh: 若是女人，你要估定三十舍客勒。
27.en: and if it is a female, set her value at thirty shekels.

27.zh: 若是从五岁到二十岁，男子你要估定二十舍客勒，女子估定十舍客勒。
27.en: If it is a person between the ages of five and twenty, set the value of a male at twenty shekels and of a female at ten shekels.

27.zh: 若是从一月到五岁，男子你要估定五舍客勒，女子估定三舍客勒。
27.en: If it is a person between one month and five years, set the value of a male at five shekels of silver and that of a female at three shekels of silver.

27.zh: 若是从六十岁以上，男人你要估定十五舍客勒，女人估定十舍客勒。
27.en: If it is a person sixty years old or more, set the value of a male at fifteen shekels and of a female at ten shekels.

27.zh: 他若贫穷，不能照你所估定的价，就要把他带到祭司面前，祭司要按许愿人的力量估定他的价。
27.en: If anyone making the vow is too poor to pay the specified amount, he is to present the person to the priest, who will set the value for him according to what the man making the vow can afford.

27.zh: 所许的若是牲畜，就是人献给耶和华为供物的，凡这一类献给耶和华的，都要成为圣。
27.en: " 'If what he vowed is an animal that is acceptable as an offering to the Lord , such an animal given to the Lord becomes holy.

27.zh: 人不可改换，也不可更换，或是好的换坏的，或是坏的换好的。若以牲畜更换牲畜，所许的与所换的都要成为圣。
27.en: He must not exchange it or substitute a good one for a bad one, or a bad one for a good one; if he should substitute one animal for another, both it and the substitute become holy.

27.zh: 若牲畜不洁净，是不可献给耶和华为供物的，就要把牲畜安置在祭司面前。
27.en: If what he vowed is a ceremonially unclean animal-one that is not acceptable as an offering to the Lord - the animal must be presented to the priest,

27.zh: 祭司就要估定价值；牲畜是好是坏，祭司怎样估定，就要以怎样为是。
27.en: who will judge its quality as good or bad. Whatever value the priest then sets, that is what it will be.

27.zh: 他若一定要赎回，就要在你所估定的价值以外加上五分之一。
27.en: If the owner wishes to redeem the animal, he must add a fifth to its value.

27.zh: 人将房屋分别为圣，归给耶和华，祭司就要估定价值。房屋是好是坏，祭司怎样估定，就要以怎样为定。
27.en: " 'If a man dedicates his house as something holy to the Lord , the priest will judge its quality as good or bad. Whatever value the priest then sets, so it will remain.

27.zh: 将房屋分别为圣的人，若要赎回房屋，就必在你所估定的价值以外加上五分之一，房屋仍旧归他。
27.en: If the man who dedicates his house redeems it, he must add a fifth to its value, and the house will again become his.

27.zh: 人若将承受为业的几分地分别为圣，归给耶和华，你要按这地撒种多少估定价值，若撒大麦一贺梅珥，要估价五十舍客勒。
27.en: " 'If a man dedicates to the Lord part of his family land, its value is to be set according to the amount of seed required for it-fifty shekels of silver to a homer of barley seed.

27.zh: 他若从禧年将地分别为圣，就要以你所估定的价为定。
27.en: If he dedicates his field during the Year of Jubilee, the value that has been set remains.

27.zh: 倘若他在禧年以后将地分别为圣，祭司就要按著未到禧年所剩的年数推算价值，也要从你所估的减去价值。
27.en: But if he dedicates his field after the Jubilee, the priest will determine the value according to the number of years that remain until the next Year of Jubilee, and its set value will be reduced.

27.zh: 将地分别为圣的人若定要把地赎回，他便要在你所估的价值以外加上五分之一，地就准定归他。
27.en: If the man who dedicates the field wishes to redeem it, he must add a fifth to its value, and the field will again become his.

27.zh: 他若不赎回那地，或是将地卖给别人，就再不能赎了。
27.en: If, however, he does not redeem the field, or if he has sold it to someone else, it can never be redeemed.

27.zh: 但到了禧年，那地从买主手下出来的时候，就要归耶和华为圣，和永献的地一样，要归祭司为业。
27.en: When the field is released in the Jubilee, it will become holy, like a field devoted to the Lord ; it will become the property of the priests.

27.zh: 他若将所买的一块地，不是承受为业的，分别为圣归给耶和华，
27.en: " 'If a man dedicates to the Lord a field he has bought, which is not part of his family land,

27.zh: 祭司就要将你所估的价值给他推算到禧年。当日，他要以你所估的价银为圣，归给耶和华。
27.en: the priest will determine its value up to the Year of Jubilee, and the man must pay its value on that day as something holy to the Lord .

27.zh: 到了禧年，那地要归卖主，就是那承受为业的原主。
27.en: In the Year of Jubilee the field will revert to the person from whom he bought it, the one whose land it was.

27.zh: 凡你所估定的价银都要按著圣所的平：二十季拉为一舍客勒。
27.en: Every value is to be set according to the sanctuary shekel, twenty gerahs to the shekel.

27.zh: 惟独牲畜中头生的，无论是牛是羊，既归耶和华，谁也不可再分别为圣，因为这是耶和华的。
27.en: " 'No one, however, may dedicate the firstborn of an animal, since the firstborn already belongs to the Lord ; whether an ox or a sheep, it is the Lord 's.

27.zh: 若是不洁净的牲畜生的，就要按你所估定的价值加上五分之一赎回；若不赎回，就要按你所估定的价值卖了。
27.en: If it is one of the unclean animals, he may buy it back at its set value, adding a fifth of the value to it. If he does not redeem it, it is to be sold at its set value.

27.zh: 但一切永献的，就是人从他所有永献给耶和华的，无论是人，是牲畜，是他承受为业的地，都不可卖，也不可赎。凡永献的是归给耶和华为至圣。
27.en: " 'But nothing that a man owns and devotes to the Lord -whether man or animal or family land-may be sold or redeemed; everything so devoted is most holy to the Lord .

27.zh: 凡从人中当灭的都不可赎，必被治死。
27.en: " 'No person devoted to destruction may be ransomed; he must be put to death.

27.zh: 地上所有的，无论是地上的种子是树上的果子，十分之一是耶和华的，是归给耶和华为圣的。
27.en: " 'A tithe of everything from the land, whether grain from the soil or fruit from the trees, belongs to the Lord ; it is holy to the Lord .

27.zh: 人若要赎这十分之一的甚么物，就要加上五分之一。
27.en: If a man redeems any of his tithe, he must add a fifth of the value to it.

27.zh: 凡牛群羊群中，一切从杖下经过的，每第十只要归给耶和华为圣。
27.en: The entire tithe of the herd and flock-every tenth animal that passes under the shepherd's rod-will be holy to the Lord .

27.zh: 不可问是好是坏，也不可更换；若定要更换，所更换的与本来的牲畜都要成为圣，不可赎回。
27.en: He must not pick out the good from the bad or make any substitution. If he does make a substitution, both the animal and its substitute become holy and cannot be redeemed.' "

27.zh: 这就是耶和华在西乃山为以色列人所吩咐摩西的命令。
